༄ga/dud dreg chags pa'i gser zangs/da wabod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyus dang spel thabs/thor god wa wawawa wawa wawa wawa/ brtsams/

shis chig 'khor 'gro'i dar dir/dud tsho 'bum phrag bstar ba'i bsil ljongs su/ /gna' bo'i dud dreg chags pa'i mes dbon gyis/ /shul bzhag rig gnas gser zangs kha sbubs pa/ /gyen du bslangs ba'i las 'di nga tsho'i 'gan/ /mi nub rang srid dbyar gyi mdza' na mo/ /shes rig 'dab ldan rtse dgas rnam bkra shing / /dpal 'byor shis brgya'i sbrang char 'bur ba'i lces/ /bde dge legs tshogs bsu ba'i ri mor 'gyu/ /gling sprul pas zla 7tshes 11la bris/

'go brjod/lo rgyus yun ring zhing chos dang rig gnas kyi dpe mdzod lta bu'i bod gangs can gyi yul 'dir/ dus rabs rim byung gi mkhas pa rnams kyis yul dus kyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas/ gsar rtsom gnang ba'i bzo dang /gso ba/ brda sprod/ tshad ma la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas bcu po las 'phros pa'i bstan bcos lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa lta bu zhig byung yod pa 'di ni rang re'i mes po rnams kyi mkhas mdzangs kyi mtshon rtags shig red/'on kyang dngos po'i dpal yon la lhag par du chags pa'i deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs nang du/ go la hril po'i mi'i 'gro ba thams cad tshan rig dang dpal 'byor yar rgyas la yong ba'i thabs lam la zhib 'jug dang 'bad brtson byas dang byed bzhin pa'i dus 'dir/ rang re bod kyi yul dus dgos mkho dang bstun nas tshan rig dang dpal 'byor skor gyi ched rtsom 'bri mkhan ni nyin mo'i skar ma ltar mthong dka' ba zhig gi gnas tshul 'di lhag yod pa red/ deng dus 'dzam gling yongs la bod rig pa la dga' zhen gyi tsha rlabs gsar pa zhig 'phyur bzhin yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ bod kyi dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul lta ci rtsam pa'i byung khungs tsam yang mi shes pa'i mi rigs gzhan dag gis bod kyi dpal 'byor gyi skor la rang snang gang 'char gyi rtsom yig tha thor bris yod pa 'di dag ni long bas long ba khrid pa'i dper las gzhan ci/da lan krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod rig pa'i tshan khag gi slob ma bka' bcu pa/ stobs ldan seng ges bod kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i dpal 'byor 'phel rim dang gnas stangs kyi lo rgyus/ mig snga bod kyi

zhing 'brog las dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul/ 'byung 'gyur zhing 'brog las sgo spel thabs dang / nags tshal dang 'khor yug srung skyob byed phyogs/bod kyi yul khams dang bstun pa'i khe las dang / bzo las/ ljongs rgyu bcas kyi las rigs gong 'phel gtong thabs skor la/ 〈 bod kyi dpal 'byor dud dreg chags pa'i gser zangs/ 〉 zhes pa'i ched rtsom zhig bris 'dug pa 'di ni/ rtsom pa po rang nyid chung lte khrag bcad nas da bar bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang du 'tshar longs byung pa'i zhing 'brog las rigs kyi nyams myong dngos dang / deng rabs 'dzam gling gi srid 'byor rig gsum gyi gnas tshul dang / 'phel rgyas skor la slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byas pa'i sbyong 'bras gnyis phan tshun zung 'brel byas nas bris pa zhig yin stabs/bod kyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong ba'i thabs dang / rig pa la gang 'tsham gyi phan thog yong nges pa dang / rang rigs gzhon nu rnams la bod kyi dpal 'byor dar spel dang / zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i dran slong dang blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde'u mig lta bu zhig yong nges pa ma zad/ deng rabs bod kyi dpal 'byor skor bod rang gi skad yig thog bris pa thog mar nges pas der brten 'brel yod dpe skrun khang nas par skrun gnang thub par byung na/ bod kyi zhing 'brog mi dmangs rnams kyi dpal 'byor bsam blo shugs che ru yong ba'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba ma zad/ bod kyi skad yig gi byed sgo dang gnas bab mtho 'degs byed rgyu'i cha rkyen du yong nges pas de bzhin ci mgyogs kyis par skrun byed nas spyi tshogs nang khyab thub pa'i re ba zhu/krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge ming pa thub bstan phun tshogs des/spyi lo 2000lo'i zla ba 4pa'i tshes 21nyin/ pe cing du bris/2

dkar chags/'go brjod/ thub bstan phun tshogs kyis/(/)le'u dang po/ bod yulango sprod mdor bsdus/ ( )sa bcad dang po/ bod kyi yul khams chags tshul/ (1)sa bcad gnyis pa/ bod mi'i 'byung khungs bshad pa/ (4)sa bcad gsum pa/ bod yul gyi phun sum tshogs pa'i rang byung dpal 'byor/ (12)gcig bod yul gyi gnam gshis/ (12)gnyis/ bod yul gyi ri rgyud/ (/4)gsum/ bod yul kyi sa dbyibs/ (/6)bzhi/ bod yul gyi chu klung / (/8)lnga / bod yul gyi mtsho dang mtshe'u/ (23)drug bod yul gyi nags tshul/ (24)bdun/ bod yul gyi gter kha/ (25)brgyad/ bod yul gyi srog chags dang rtsi shing / (26)dgu/ bod yul kyi rtswa thang / (28)bcu/ bod rigs 'tsho sdod grong khyer dang sa khul/ rdzong bcas kyi ming / (28)le'u gnyis pa/ bod kyi gna' rabs dpala'abyor/ (35)sa bcad dang po/ gna' rabs bod kyi phyugs las dpal 'byor/ (35)sa bcad gnyis pa/ gna' rabs bod kyi zhing las dpal 'byor/ (37)

sa bcad gsum pa/ gna' rabs bod kyi shes rig dpal 'byor/ (40)sa bcad bzhi pa/ gna' rabs bod kyi tshong las dpal byor/ (43)le'u gsum pa/ bod btsan po'i dus rabs kyi dpal 'byor/ (45)sa bcad dang po/ phyugs las dpal 'byor/ (45)sa bcad gnyis pa/ zhing las dpal 'byor/ (47)sa bcad gsum pa/ bzo las dpal 'byor/ (50)sa bcad bzhi pa/ tshong las dpal 'byor/ (54)le'u bzhi pa/ bod sil bur 'thor rjes kyi dpal 'byor/ (58)sa bcad dang po/ bod sil ba'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/ (58)sa bcad gnyis pa/ sa skya ba'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/ (60)sa bcad gsum pa/ phag mo gru ba'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/ (62)gcig spyi tshogs dpal 'byor lam lugs legs bcos byas tshul/ (63)gnyis/ lag shes bzo las dar tshul/ (64)sa bcad bzhi pa/ gtsang pa rgyal bo'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/ (67)sa bcad lnga ba/ dge ldan pa'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/ (67)sa bcad drug pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis bod dpal 'byor la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen/ (68)le'u lnga ba/ bod dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi thar lam (76)sa bcad dang po/ bod kyi deng rabs zhing las spel thabs/ (78)gcig zhing las thon skyed kyi shes rtogs mthor 'degs gtong dgos/ (79)gnyis/ zhing sa srung skyong dang legs bcos byed dgos/ (80)2

gsum/ tshan rtsal la brten nas zhing ra'i khor yug 'dzugs skrun bya dgos/ (8 )bzhi/ zhing las lag rtsal mi sna gso skyong bya dgos/ (82)sa bcad gnyis pa/ bod kyi deng rabs 'brog las spel thabs/ (83)gcig spang ljongs legs bcos dang do dam bya dgos/ (84)gnyis/ rtswa sna 'debs gnyer khe las 'dzugs dgos/ (85)gsum/ phyugs rgyud legs bcos dang do dam tshad mthor gtong dgos/ (86)bzhi/ phyugs las thon skyed dang 'brel ba'i bzo grwa spel 'dzugs bya dgos/ (87)sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi deng rabs nags las spel thabs/ (88)gcig nags tshal srung skyob dang do dam legs po bya dgos/ (89)gnyis/ khor yug sngo ljang can du bsgyur bar 'bad brtson bya dgos/(89)gsum/ nags las bzo grwa 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos/ (90)sa bcad bzhi pa/ bod kyi deng rabs nya las spel thabs/ (92)gcig nya las shes rtogs je mthor gtong dgos/ (93)gnyis/ nya las do dam tshad mthor gtong dgos/ (94)gsum/ nya las khe las 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos/ (95)sa bcad lnga ba/ bod kyi deng rabs bzo las spel thabs/ (95)gcig yul bstun bzo grwa 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos/ (97)gnyis/ bdag gnyer do dam sgrig gzhi dam tshags bya dgos/ (98)gsum/ mnyam 'brel khe las btsugs nas bcos bsgyur sgo 3

'byed rgyun 'khyongs bya dgos/ (99)bzhi/ shes ldan mi nang sna 'dren gso skyong bya dgos/ (100)sa bcad drug pa/ yul skor las rigs spel thabs/ ( 01)gcig yul skor las rigs kyi shes rtogs je mthor gtong dgos// (103)gnyis/ yul skor thon khungs srung skyob dang legs bcos bya dgos/( 05)gsum/ yul skor ched gnyer mi sna bsdu skyong legs po bya dgos// ( 06)bzhi/ yul skor khyab bsgrags rgya cher bya bar shugs snon bya dgos/ ( 07)lnga/ spyi sger gnyis kyi yul skor las rigs gnyer bar brtson dgos// (108)mjug gtam/ (/)

le'u dang po/ bod yul ngo sprod mdor bsdus/sa bcad dang po/ bod kyi yul khams chags tshul/ de yang 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉 du ‘‘mtsho de 'khol ba zhi zhing rab tu bsil/ /kong gi chu brlag ces bya'i zom phyes bas/ /ru bzhi chu yis gang ba de ru thim/ /bod khams yul gyi rnam pa gsal bor rdod//’’zhes gsungs ba nang bzhin/ 'dzam gling gi yang steng ngam a she ya'i dkyil dbus te/ sa'i go la'i 'phred thig byang ma'i tshad 25༷ —420 kyi bar dang /gzhung thig gi tshad 75༷ —105༷ tsam gyi bar du gangs ljongs sam kha ba can du 'bod pa'i yul khams 'di chags shing / lho mtha' rgya gar (1baspu1 'i)dang / nub mtha' pā ki su thān (2'ismo151'ib)bcas kyi rgyal khab dang byang shang rang rgyal gyi li yul sogs kyi mi rigs gzhan gyi yul dang 'brel yod/ rgan thub bstan phun tshogs lags kyi slob khrid zin bris zhig tu ‘‘sa gnas so so'i spyi bshad rgya yig dang 1982lo'i mi 'bor zhib bsher thengs gsum pa'i bsdoms rtsis ltar na/ bod yul spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi ma 2400000tsam yod pa dang / de las bod rang skyong ljongs yongs kyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 1200000lhag tsam dang / si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 153870tsam/ rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 83426 tsam/ lo so rang skyong khul gyi mnga' 1

khongs su yod pa'i rmu gling bod rigs rang skyong rdzong yongs kyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma12000lhag tsam/ yun nan zhing chen bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 23870lhag tsam/ mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho shar bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 17000lhag tsam/ mtsho byang sa khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 52000lhag tsam/ mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 46000lhag tsam/ mtsho nub bod sog khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 320900lhag tsam/ yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 267000lhag tsam/ rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 17902lhag tsam/ kan su'u zhing chen kan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 45000lhag tsam/ kan su'u zhing chen dpa' ris bod rigs rang skyong rdzong gi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 8000lhag tsam zin yod ces gsal ba ma zad/ da dung si khron phin wu'u rdzong khongs su bod rigs (ngopaṃ ṣṭha)mi 'bor 10000lhag dang /sa dam rdzong (tshe71ṣpe)khongs su bod rigs 1400lhag tsam 'jang khra 'bum dgon rdzong (rsāsgreṣpe)khongs su bod rigs 1290lhag tsam/ nyen lam rdzong (bheo྾ṣpe)khongs su bod rigs 7000lhag tsam/ ar yān rdzong (༈྾ṣpe)khongs su bod rigs 200lhag tsam/ 'jang da li (rkimmuṣpe)rdzong khongs su bod rigs 170lhag tsam/ he ching rdzong (tshoṣṭhaṣpe)khongs su 'dus sdod bod rigs 30lhag tsam/ yangs pa'i rdzong ( sdzamiṣpe)khongs su 'dus sdod bod rigs 20lhag tsam/ g.yung hrin rdzong (kṣe.oṃsngo)khongs su 'dus sdod bod rigs sum cu lhag tsam yod’’zhes 'dug pa dang / 〈 deng rabs bod ljongs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus 〉zhes pa'i nang du ‘‘ si 2

byang gnyis mtho ste/ mnga' ris dang nag chu sogs mtsho ngos las mtho tshad spyi le gru bzhi ma 4500tsam zin pas/ cha snyoms mtsho ngos mtho tshad 2800lhag tsam zin gyi yod/sa bcad gnyis pa/ bod mi'i 'byung khungs bshad pa/tā ar bun ( 7lospra)gyi〈 dngos po'i 'phel 'gyur smra ba 〉zhes pa'i nang ‘‘dngos po yod tshad 'phel 'gyur gyi nang 'tshos yod/ mi'ang spra 'gyur nas byung ba yinaririces mi'i rigs kyi 'byung khungs spra yin pa thag gcod byas yod cing / tag tag mi ni spra nas 'gyur ba zhig yin nam/ spra rigs de tshos 'tsho thabs kyi ngal rtsol byas ba tsam gyis mir 'gyur nus sam/ srog chags gzhan dag la'ang ci'i phyir mi'i rigs dang 'dra ba'i phyi rabs pa ma byung ba yin nam/ da lta'i spra rigs de tsho da dung mir mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang ci yin nam/ da dung spra rigs mdog gcig las med cing / mi'i rigs la ci'i phyir kha dog mi 'dra ba byung ba yin rgyu red/ ngas mi'i rigs 'di spra rigs kho na las mched pa zhig yin par mi srid 'dod kyi yod/kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar/ bod kyi mi'ang ‘‘spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang ma brag srin mo gnyis 'dus nas byung ba yin’’zer/ don dngos de 'dra zhig yin nam/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa' yang spra rigs sha stag gcig yin thag chod dam/ brag srin mo de'ang ngo ma srin mo zhig yin rgyu e red/ ngas 'di ltar dris tshe/ kun gyis spre'u byang chub sems dpa' ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba dang / brag srin mo ni sgrol ma'i sprul ba yin zhes tshig thag gcod nges 'dod/ 'o na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 4

dang sgrol ma gnyis ni ci lta bu'i 'gro ba zhig yin/ de gnyis kyang spra'am srin po'i rigs su gtogs sam/ lha'am bdud kyi rigs su gtogs srid kyi red zhe na/ bod mi mkhas blun su 'i/ga yin yang phal cher nam mkhar mdzub mo ker nas ‘‘lha yin’’zer nges 'dod/ 'o na/ lha zhes pa de'i gnas yul gang yin nam/ rigs kyang ci lta bu zhig yin tshod red/ tag tag sprin pa dkar nag gi rgyu ba ltar bar snang stong ba'i dbyings su 'tsho ba'i gzugs med rdzu 'phrul byang ba zhig yin srid kyi red dam/ 'di ltar bsam gzhig gi steng ka nas rig 'ded kyi gshog 'gyur ldem tshe/ ngas nam rgyun ‘ lha’’zhes pa ni phyi go la'i rigs shig dang / mi'i rigs ni phyi go la'i steng gi mi (nya/rikṣurki)dang spra rigs 'dus nas byung ba zhig yin shas chen po red 'dod kyi yod/ rgyu mtshan/(1)‘‘'dzam gling gnam rig ched mkhas dag gis tshod rtsis byas bar/phra mthong rgyang shel gyis mthong thub pa'i khor yug na/ brtan skar phal cher 1020yod/ gal te brtan skar 1000gi nang du 'khor skar 1 yod pa dang /'khor rgyu yod pa'i brtan skar khrod kyi 1/7la tshe srog la mkho ba'i cha rkyen 'dzoms pa'i dbang du btang ba'i mjug 'bras su da dung 104tsam lhag 'dugagal te/ 'khor skar 'di dag gi khrod kyi da/krogi steng du tshe srog gnas bar mkho ba'i rlung rim chen po yod na/ da dung 'khor skar 10 la tshe srog 'tsho thub pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen tshang 'dug grangs 'bor 'dis mi la 'jigs snang ster ba zhig red/ yin na'ang / nga tshos yang bskyar de'i khrod kyi 'khor skar 1 0gi steng du tshe srog byung zin pa'i dbang du btang na/ da dung 'khor skar dung phyur 1 gi steng du tshe srog gnas 'dug gal te/ nga tshos gom gang mdun spos kyi 'khor skar 100yi nang gi 'khor skar 1 gi steng du ngo ma tshe srog 5

'tsho thub pa'i dbang du btang na/ da dung tshe srog 'tsho thub pa'i 'khor skar khri 100'dug ’’ces gsal bas/ tshan rig gi rtsal la bsten nas da gzod phyi skar mi yod pa tshod dpag thub par 'jigs snang dang ya mtshan skye bzhin yod cing / rang cag bod kyi rig gnas su ‘‘gling bzhi ri rab 'dod lha drug tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang bcas pa la gling bzhi ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya la/ de stong la dang po spyi phud stong gi 'jig rten zhes bya'o// de stong la bar ma'i stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / de stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten zhes bya ste/ de na gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya ste/ ther 'bum re yod pa de ni mchog gi sprul sku gcig gi 'dul zhing ngo / de ltar bshad pa ni mi mjed kyi 'jig rten 'di'i dbang du byas kyi/gzhan du sems can gyi las snang dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang gis/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad du/ zhing la la chags bzhin pa/ la la gnas ba/ la la 'jig pa/ la la dag pa/ la la ma dag pa/ de bzhin du rgya che chung dang dbyibs dang bkod pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul lo ’’zhes 〈 mkhas 'jug 〉sogs su gsal bar dpyad na/ bod mi tshos sngon nas phyi skar khri phrag mang po yod pa ma zad/ de la tshe srog dang mi'i rigs 'tsho ba rtogs 'dug pas/ ya mtshan nam 'jigs snang skye dgos don med la/ skye'ang mi srid cing /gna' rabs bod mi de tshos ci ltar shes ba yin par dpyad rin yod par 'dod/ kho tsho'i tshan rig lag rtsal de da lta dang 'dra ba'am da lta las kyang lhag pa zhig dar nas shes ba yin rgyu red dam/ phyi skar mis brgyud bsgrags byas nas nges ba zhig yin rgyu red/ yang na tag tag sbra nag dang sa khang las 6

bsam gzhig dang rig 'ded bgyis te rtogs pa zhig yin nges red/(2) mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus yod tshad mngon sum yin stabs/ sus kyang sgro 'dogs dang 'khyogs bshad byed mi 'os la/ srid dbang dang ma 'brel ba'i gnad don zhig la de ltar byed dgos med la byed kyang mi srid/ bod la mtshon na/ 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉 du ‘‘bod khams yul du rung bar gyur nas kyang // dang po mi ma yin gyi yul du gyur// de nas re te mgo g.yag bdud gyis byas// de nas srin po gnya' rengs khrag mig byas// bzhi ba dmar 'jam lha yis dbang byas te// lnga ba rmu rgyal kho rje zhes byas bzung // drug pa krog krog 'dre yi dbang byas te// bdun pa ma sangs rus dgus dbang byas te// brgyad pa klus bzung bod khams gling dgu btags// dgu ba rgyal pos dbang byas ngam po ci//bcu bo 'gong po dbun dgus dbang byas ste// zhes grag go de nas mi yi 'gro ba byung tshul ni// sprul ba'i spre'u brag srin 'dus ba las//ris drug nas 'phos spre'u phrug drug/ zhig byung // de las mi min spre'u min bzhi brgya 'phel// klo dang mon ltar spyod pas bod yul gang // de ltar bod yul mi yi 'gro ba byung //’’zhes thog mar spra dang srin po sogs mi ma yin pas bod yul bzung ba dang / de nas spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma (lha zhes ba phyi skar mi'i rigs shig yin par snang )gnyis kyi sprul ba'i spre'u srin bsdebs nas da gzod phyi skar mi'i rgyud pa te da lta'i mi'i rigs 'di byung ba yin pa bstan par 'dod la/ da dung ‘‘'od gsal lha las chad pa’’zhes de las kyang gsal bor bstan 'dug par 'dod//nub gling bar mtshon na'ang de bzhin red/ ‘‘'jig rten gyi mi dang 7

dngos rigs yod tshad lha chen pos bzos pa yin’’zhes brjod kyi yod pa ltar red/ 'on kyang / dngos rigs thams cad bzos bar mi 'thad cing /dngos rigs sgyur bkod dang nub gling mi'i rigs rgyud gsar spel byed mkhan yin shas chen po red/ rgyu mtshan/ 'jar man (6617'ib)skad rig pa hri rmā thu(tsho.oṃlhargo)chos dpon gyis zhib 'jug byas par/ rgya gar dang nub gling mi rigs kyi chos lugs las/ yar gyi lha'am gnam bdag zhes pa 'od 'phro ba'i don yin pa dang / da dung 〈 dam pa'i gsung rabs〉nang du ‘‘lha chen po zhes pa gna' bo'i zhi pha'o la'e(lko4khrilko)skad kyi nang du ‘‘bar snang nas yong ba'i mi rnams’’ces pa'i don yin par gsung 'dug pas/ da dung dogs snang skye dgos don yod dam/ —(3ke bar snang khams su 'khor skar dang gza' skar khri 'bum mang po yod la/ 'jig rten khams su'ang dud 'gro dang 'dab chags khri 'bum mang po yod/ da dung 'dab chags la'ang nang gses dang dud 'gro la'ang dud 'gro'i rigs rgyud ha cang mang po yod cing / smra shes shing don go ba/ blo rig gsal ba'i srog chags mi'i rigs gcig pu yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/mi'i rigs la nang gses med pa'i rgyu mtshan yang ci yin nam/ ngas ‘6lha ’’zhes pa sogs kyi 'gro ba de dag kyang dngos su yod pa ma zad/ phyi skar mi'i rigs shig yin par 'dod kyi yod la/ sngon dang por 'jig rten 'di'i steng du 'tsho ba'i sems can rnams kyis gcig gis gcig za bzhin pa'i rnam pa sgyur bkod dam dbang sgyur byed ched/ phyi skar mi spra rigs dang bsdebs nas nga tsho'i mi'i rigs 'di byung ba yin tshod red bsam gyi yod/(4) 'jig rten gyi gsang ba gcig rtogs snang re byung na/ de las kyang 8

lkog tu gyur ba lta bu'i gsang ba bcu phrag re 'byung bzhin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/ tshan rig rig gnas gong tu 'phel ba dang bstun nas/ 'jig rten gyi gsang ba'ang ldab 'gyur mang po mngon bzhin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang ci yin rgyu red/ lhag par du bod ljongs la mtshon na/ byis pa tsho'i lha mjal 'dre mthong dang / grub thob tsho'i lha babs bdud btul/ rgan rgon tsho'i lha rgyus klu rabs/ nad pa tsho'i btsan gnyan gdon 'phrad/ skyes dar tsho'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag skyes dman tsho'i chu bdag sa bdag grwa btsun tsho'i sa thob mgon rnyed/ yul skor ba'i don 'grub dad skyes/ lo rgyus ba'i gling sgrung sham bha la/ shi logs pa'i gshin rje'i dmyal khams/ bla sprul tsho'i 'ja' lus gdong bzhugs/ sngags pa tsho'i gshed 'ded bla bkug rdzi bo tsho'i the'u ring sgrung 'bab/ da dung gling rje ge sar ma shir dmyal bar phebs tshul dang /rgya tsha zhal dkar dang gong sman rgyal mo nam mkha' byon tshul/ 'ju mi pham gyis mdan ma'i rdzong mkhar mthong tshul/ sba gsal snang gi bu mo rang khyim du slar skyes tshul/ stag pu ba dkar gyi dbang phyug gi sngon rabs dran tshul/'jam dbyangs bzhad par 'jam dbyangs bzhad tshul/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs las 'od gor gsum 'phros pas srong btsan rgya bza' bal bza' gsum 'khrungs tshul/ sgrung mkhan grags par gling sgrung babs tshul/paṇa chen bcu ba'i zhal gzugs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas mngon tshul/ khyim tshang la la gzhi bdag gis khyer tshul/ byang phyogs sham bha la'i sa khra ste dkyil 'khor gyi thig gsal tshul sogs kyi rlom dka' ba'i gnas tshul ngo mtshar can mang pos bod khams mi yul min pa lta bu'i lkog gyur zhig tu chags pa 'grel nus med pa'i rtsa gnad de bas kyang ci yin nam/ mig mthong lag zin tu 9

la 'phur ba'i nam mkha'i mi mtho tshad dbyin ci'i khri tsi brgya lhag yod pa (dbyin khri gsum dang cha phran gsum spyi khri gang gi tshad yin)lus la 'od 'phro ba brgyad mthong nas dpar rgyab 'dug pas/ de las mngon pa mdzod sogs su khams gong ma dang skar ma sogs kyi steng na/ lha zhes pa'i sems can 'od dang rdzu 'phrul can yod pa dang / de dag gi lus kyi mtho tshad khams 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma che tshul/ 'phags pa thogs med dga' ldan du byon nas nyin gcig gi yun la byams chos gsan te phyir byon dus mi lo lnga bcu 'gor zhes pa'i gtam rgyud de tsho bden pa'i shes byed rnyed/ nye char a ri'i mis bzos rgyu skar steng nas dpar blangs pa las me skar te gza' lhag pa'i steng na shin tu che ba'i rdo sku dang / mchod rten zur gsum lta bu dang /mkhar gzhis rnying ba'i shul sogs yod par snang la/ de las skar ma sogs kyi zhing khams dang sems can yod par gsungs ba de nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 'os tshod min par shes’’ces gsal ba dang / 2000lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 17nyin gyi 〈 lho phyogs gza' mjug〉(tshe.oṃṣālko)gi shog ngos dgu ba'i steng du ‘‘nye sngon dbyi si le'i(ṭhathusto/1)tshan rig pa to pu'u lu'u hphu'u (lturkozlorke)yis ‘‘e tsi 'gos nad (sprasgyu skyulo)ni 'jig rten gyi nad rigs shig yin cing /sa'i go la'i steng gi sa skyes rdo skyes kyi nad rigs shig min pa ma zad/ mi'i rigs sa'i go lar 'tsho ba'i re 'dod brgal nas go la gzhan pa'i steng du 'phur ba'i go rim las thob pa'i thon rdzas shig red/ yin na'ang / mig sngar mi'i rigs kyis e tsi 'gos nad da dung yongs su sngon 'gog dang / rang mgul gyis thar ba/ sman bcos byed thub med cing / de ni da rung mi rigs 'jig rten du skor skyod byed pa'i dgra zla gcig pu ma red ’’ces bsgrags pa 11

sogs kyi gnas tshul 'di rigs byung ba nyung nyung ma red/ de'i phyir/ phyi skar ma'i lus kyi spyod pa dang / phyi'i rnam pa/ yid kyi rtogs pa/ rig gnas dpal 'byor/ tshan rig lag rtsal bcas yod tshad nga tsho dang bsdur na ldab 'gyur gyis sngon thon yin pa ma zad/ 'jig rten 'di'i rig gnas (dper na/chos lugs la la'i gdams ngag la la'am lung ston tshul/ e tsi 'gos nad lta bu)la la'ang phyi skar mi'i rig gnas dang 'brel ba yod shas che rgyu red 'dod kyi yod/sa bcad gsum pa/ bod yul gyi phun sum tshogs pa'i rang byung dpal 'byor/spyir bod yul ni 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉 du‘‘ beeṭurya yi sa gzhi la/ gser gyis mig mangs ris su bris/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'khyil zhing 'bab// ye shes gsal ba'i me 'od 'bar// rin chen byang chub shing gis gtams// padma'i sbubs las brdzus te skye//’’zhes gsungs ba ltar ro/gcig bod yul gyi gnam gshis/ 'dzam gling yul khams so so'i sa dbyibs dang / sa bab mi 'dra bas rkyen byas te/ gnam gshis kyang mi 'dra ba chags yong gi yod/ gnam gshis dro grang mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur ldog la rten nas yul lung so sos thon skyed las rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs gnyer gyi yod stabs/ gnam gshis kyi drod grang ni zhing phyug las rigs kun gyi rang byung thon khungs gal chen zhig yin/ des mi'i rigs kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la'ang shugs rkyen chen po thebs kyi yod/ bod yul du'ang sa bab dang mtsho rlangs kyi dbang gis sa khul so so'i dro grang la khyad par cung tsam yod 12

cing / spyir bshad na/ mkhas dbang don 'grub rgyal gyis/‘‘dgun gsum 'khyags pas bsdams pa'i skyed tshul du//dpyid gsum dri bzhon ldang bas sa chu dros//dbyar gsum lo ma rgyas pa'i ljon shing rtser//ston gsum 'bras bu smin pa'i sta gon byed//phyogs bzhi gangs ris bskor ba'i yul gru 'dir//dus bzhi'i dbye ba 'di ltar gsal lags kyang //’’zhes gsungs pa ltar dus bzhi'i rnam pa gsal zhing / shar lho gnyis kyi dma' sa'i drod tshad de nub byang mtho sgang dang sdur na mthon po yod/(1) bod yul gyi nyi 'od 'phro yun yang tshad dang mthun po yod/ dper na/bod rang skyong ljongs kyi lo re'i cha snyoms nyi 'od 'phro ba'i dus tshod 1600—3400tsam zin yod/ lo hril bo'i nyi 'od 'phro nus pa'i dus tshod kyi brgya cha'i 34—77tsam zin 'dug lha sa grong khyer gyi lo re'i cha snyoms nyi 'od 'phro ba'i dus tshod 3005tsam zin yod/ nyi 'od kyi dro tshad kyang mthon po yod pas/byang gi 'phred thig gi tshad mthun par gnas pa'i nying pho'o (oṃkhāe)la dus tshod 2087 tsam dang khrung chin (rsāṭha)la dus tshod 1188tsam las zin gyi med/ de'i phyir/ lha sa grong khyer la‘‘nyi 'od grong khyer’’zhes 'bod kyi yod pa'ang ha cang don dang mthun par 'dod/(2) rlung rlangs ni nyin mtshan dus bzhi'i 'khor 'gros dang bstun nas 'gyur ba cung tsam 'byung srid cing / spyir btang bod yul gyi rlung ni sa cha gzhan dang sdur na/ drod tshad ran zhing g.yug yun ring po yin/ dper na/lha sa grong khyer gyi lo re'i cha snyoms drod tshad 7 5bu dang / ches 'khyags pa'i 13

skabs kyi zla re'i cha snyoms drod tshad —2 20 tsam las dma' med la/ ches dro ba'i skabs kyi zla re'i cha snyoms drod tshad 15 5du tsam las mtho mi srid pas/mkha' dbugs srab kyang rlung gnon dang char chu/ sad bcas tshad dang ran pa sogs kyi bzang cha mang po yod/(3) bod yul gyi nyi 'od dang rlung sogs kyang rang byung thon khungs gal chen zhig yin/ zhing phyugs las rigs kun la rang grub nus pa chen po thebs kyi yod/ da dung tshan rig lag rtsal dar spel byung tshe/ nyi glog dang 'od khang /'od thab/ rlung glog sogs kyi mis bzos spyod chas mang por bkol nus che ba'i thon khungs rtsa chen zhig yin/gnyis/ bod yul gyi ri rgyud/ bod yul la ‘‘gangs ri'i rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i gnas ’’zhes pa'i 'bod srol 'dug pa ji bzhin dngos gnas mtho zhing gzar la/ rngam brjid ldan pa'i ri rgyud mang po yod/ 'dzam gling gi gtsug rgyan lta bur gyur ba'i ri bo jo mo glang ma gtso byas pa'i rma chen sbom ra dang / gnyan chen thang lha/ khro zil khrom/ gangs dkar ri bo/ gangs ti se/rong btsan kha ba dkar po/ yar lha sham po sogs ri rgyud dag ni mtshams mtshams su krong nger langs yod/ (1) hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud/ bod nub phyogs kyi pha smir (snyekhrilkolo)mtho sgang nas brtsams te/ rgya yig ‘‘lku’’yi dbyibs kyis lho mtha'i rgyal khab rgya gar dang bal bo sogs dang rgyal mtshams su chags pa'i gzhung rgyug ri rgyud che shos yin/ ring tshad spyi le 2 500tsam dang zheng tshad spyi le 200—350tsam zin 'dug mtsho ngos las cha snyoms mtho tshad smi 6000lhag tsam yin/ ri rgyud 'di'i nang du mtsho ngos las mtho tshad smi 7000yan zin pa'i ri bo 50 14

lhag tsam dang / mtho tshad smi 8000las brgal ba'i ri chen 10yod pas/'dzam gling gi mtho tshad smi 8000brgal ba'i ri chen 14yod pa'i 77 4phrozin yod/ mtho tshad smi 8848 13tsam zin pa'i 'dzam gling gi ri bo mtho shos jo mo glang ma'ang ri rgyud 'di'i dkyil te/ bal bod sa mtshams su chags yod/1960lo'i zla 5tshes 25nyin dang 1975lo'i zla 5tshes 27nyin so sor rang rgyal gyi ri 'dzegs lus rtsal ba tsho snga phyir ri bo 'di'i rtse mor 'dzegs pa nas da bar 'dzam gling dang rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig rtog zhib dang ri 'dzegs lus rtsal tshan chung mang po 'byor myong ba las/ bod dam krung go ma zad/'dzam gling yongs kyi lus rtsal ra ba'am rtog dpyod gnas mchog bla na med pa zhig yin pa shes thub/(2) 'phred rgyug ri rgyud/ ri rgyud 'di ni gnyan chen thang lha dang gdang la'i ri rgyud la 'brel nas bod shar phyogs nas nub phyogs su rgyug pa'i tshul gyis chags shing / mtsho ngos las mtho tshad smi 4000da 5000tsam yin/ ri rgyud 'di'i lung gzhung la lar kha zheng smi 1000—2000tsam yod pa'i grog rong zab mo'i nang du gna' bo'i dus rim bzhi ba'i 'khyags klung chags yod pas/ bod kyi phyi snon 'jig rten chags tshul gsal bor rtogs thub par bshad/(3) kha ra khu nu ri rgyud/ ri rgyud 'di ni khu hri me ar dang li yul gyi nub byang mtha' mtshams su chags shing / bod ljongs nub phyogs kyi pha smir mtho sgang dang 'brel yod/ shar phyogs su rgyugs pa'i cha shas tsam bod nang khul du yod pa las mang che ba khu hrin mes ar du chags yod/ cha snyom sa mtsho ngos mtho tshad smi 6000tsam zin yod/15

(4) gangs te si'i ri rgyud/ 'di ni bod yul dkyil gyi byang phyogs mtho sgang dang lho phyogs lung khul gnyis kyi bar mtshams su chags yod/ mtsho ngos las cha snyoms mtho tshad smi 5500—5800tsam yin/ ri chen gtso bo gangs rin po che yin la/ mtsho ngos mtho tshad smi 6700tsam zin yod/ ri rgyud 'di'i shar sne 'brel ba'i gnyan chen thang lha'i ri rgyud gyi mtsho ngos cha snyoms mtho tshad smi 5800—6000tsam yin/ ri chen gtso bo gnyan chen thang lha mtsho ngos las mtho tshad smi 7117tsam yin/spyir bshad na/ bod yul lho phyogs su hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud dang / shar phyogs su 'phred rgyug ri rgyud/ nub phyogs su kha ra khu nu ri rgyud/ byang phyogs su gdang la'i ri rgyud/ yul dbus su gangs ti se'i ri rgyud bcas kyis yongs su bskor 'dug pa lta bu zhig chags 'dug rkyen/ mtha' 'brel mi rigs sam rgyal khab khag dang tshong las brje spel byed pa sogs phyi nang gnyis kyi dpal 'byor 'gro rgyug 'grim 'grul thad la bkag rgya chen po thebs kyi yod pa yo zad/phyogs kun gyi mtsho rlung 'gog gi 'dug stabs/ gnam gshis dro grang dang /thon skyed las rigs/ phyi nang 'gro 'ong sogs la'ang shugs rkyen chen po thebs kyi yod/gsum/ bod kyi sa dbyibs/ deb ther 〈 mkhas bri'i dga' ston〉du ‘‘stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing gi tshul// bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba 'dra// smad du mdo khams sgang drug zhing lta bu// kun kyang chu yi rgya mtsho lta bur gyur ba'i nang ’’ces kyang gsal la/ bod yul spyi'i sa dbyibs ni stag mo tshang la nyal ba phyir nger bzhin pa dang mi 'dra'am bsam gyi yod/(1kye byang phyogs sa mtho'i khul/ byang phyogs sa mtho'i khul zhes pa khu nu 16

dang gdang la/ gangs ti se sogs ri rgyud chen po gsum dang gnyan chen thang lha'i bar du chags pa'i yangs shing rgya che ba'i byang thang sa khul du ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ mtsho ngos las cha snyoms mtho tshad smi 4500zin yod/ dkyus la spyi le 2400lhag tsam dang / zheng la spyi le 700lhag tsam 'dug da dung mtho tshad smi 100—400bar zin pa'i sgang 'bur mang po'i 'dab rol gyi mtha' yas ba'i spang thang du chu bo dang mtshe'u mod pas/ phyugs las gnyer ba'i rang byung cha rkyen 'dzoms po yod/ phyugs las gtso gnyer gyi mnga' ris kyang sa khul 'di'i khongs su gtogs/(2)lho phyogs lung gzhung khul/ sa khul 'di gangs te se dang hi ma la ya ri rgyud gnyis kyi bar du gnas shing / yar klung gtsang po dang de'i chu lag chen po skyid chu dang / myang chu/ nyang chu gsum 'bab yul gyi lung gzhung mang pa'i sa khul zhig yin/ lung gzhung de tsho'i zheng tshad spyi le 5—8bar dang / ring tshad spyi le 70—100lhag tsam zin yod/ khul 'di'i shar nub bar thag spyi le1200dang lho byang bar thag spyi le300—700bar yin/ cha snyoms mtsho ngos mtho tshad smi 3500yas mas zhig yin/ da dung sa gshis gshin la chu phran mang pas/ rtsi shing dang lo tog sna tshogs kyi thon khungs gtso bo zhig yin/(3) hi ma la yi'i ri khul/ sngar brjod ltar rgya gar dang bal bo/ 'brug yul/ 'bras ljongs bcas kyi rgyal khab dang 'brel mtshams su gnas zhing /ri rgyud mang ba'i sa khul zhig yin/ shar nub bar thag spyi le 2400lhag tsam dang / lho byang bar thag spyi le200—350tsam yod/ mtsho ngos las cha snyoms mtho tshad smi 6000yas mas yin/ nub rgyud sa mtho zhing gnam gshis grang mod/ shar rgyud dro la char chu bzang bas nags tshal thon khungs stug po yod/17

(4)byang shar mtho sgang khul/ gdang la'i ri rgyud kyi byang phyogs dang /rmin hran (spekhu①)dang / she'u chen ri rgyud (khro4lo①sto/))kyi nub phyogs/ mdo la ring mo(rnyekhu ༅①glotsā)ri rgyud kyi byang phyogs/ li sar bo'u lan po'u sung ri rgyud kyi shar phyogs khul te/ gtso bo kan su'u dang mtsho sngon khongs su gtogs yod/ lho nub tu khu nu ri bo'i smad rgyud dang / ba yan ha ri'i rgyud/ rma chen gangs kyi ri rgyud sogs yod pas/ sa mtho zhing ri chen mang po yod/ byang du tha li mu'u gzhung sa yod pas/ bye thang ngam grog rong mang la skam gshis che/shar lho dma' zhing dro ba sogs kyi khyad chos ldan/ yul spyi'i cha snyoms mtsho ngos mtsho tshad phal cher smi4000da 5000tsam yin la/ shar nub bar thag spyi le1380dang / lho byang bar thag spyi le 580lhag yin/(5) shar phyogs ri mtho grog rong khul/ de ni sog rdzong shar phyogs dang 'ba' lung byang phyogs/ dar rtse mdo'i nub phyogs/ ba yan ha ri'i lho phyogs/bod shar lho'i mtshams kyi phred rgyug ri rgyud dang gtsang chen gsum rgyug yul gyi sa khul du ngos 'dzin dgos/ khul 'di'i byang phyogs su brag ri g.yang gzar can med cing / rgya mabyo1re ngos las smi 5200tsam mtho bas/ gnam gshis grang zhing skam gshis che/ lho rgyud du ri gzar dang grog rong rngam shing sa brtsing / mtsho ngos mtho tshad las smi 4000tsam las zin med pas/ gnam gshis dro grang ran zhing mdzes sdug ldan pa'i rtsi shing dang nags tshal yod par bshad/bzhi/ bod yul gyi chu klung / de yang 〈 rgya bod yig tshang 〉chen mo'i nang du ‘‘'dzam bu gling gi sa tshad lte ba/ bod gangs can 'di yin par 'dod pa ni/ sa mtho/ ri mang / gangs chags chu bo thams cad 'di nas phyi'i 18

mtha' rnams su 'bab phyir/ 'di nyid sa'i dbus yin par 'dod do/’rizhes gsungs ba nang bzhin bod yul du chu klung ha cang mang zhing chu'i thon khungs phun sum tshogs pas/ a she ya gling (rlu51'i)gi chu mdzod lta bur chags yod la/'dzam gling yongs kyi chu mdzod che gras shig yin zhes mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas lab chog chog yin/ bod rang skyong ljongs cig pur mtshon na/bzhur yul rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 10000las brgal ba'i chu klung 20lhag dang / bzhur yul rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 2000las brgal ba'i chu bo 200lhag tsam yod/ chu klung de tsho'i chu gshis bzang zhing gtsang bas/ da lta 'dzam gling yongs su dkon pa'i rang byung sman chu'am lha phab bdud rtsi yin zhes bshad kyang 'gal ba med par 'dod /chu klung de tsho bod yul gyi gangs ri chen po so so nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du 'bab zhing / a she ya gling gi lus kyi zungs khrag lta bur gyur 'dug pas/ gna' bo'i e she ya gling gi rig gnas kyi 'byung rtsa kho na yin par phyi nang mkhas grub kun gyis mgrin gcig tu smra bzhin yod pa ci'i phyir zhe na/'di lta ste/gna' bo'i rgya gar rig gnas ni chu bo gaṅgas skyed par rgya gar ba rang ma zad/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi khas len ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod la/ rgya gar bas ‘‘nā kha nā le'u 'am gaṅga ’’zhes 'bod pa'i chu klung 'di ni bod yul gyi gangs rin po che las byung ba'i ‘‘glang chen kha 'bab yin/ yang rgya gar ba la las gna' bo'i rgya gar rig gnas chu bo gaṅgas skyed pa ma yin par/ rgya gar chu bos skyed pa yin ’’zer mkhan yod cing / rgya gar chu bo'ang gangs te se las byung ba'i chu klung chen po seng ge kha 'bab yin pas/ a she ya'i rig gnas kyi 19

'byung rtsa lta bu'i rgya gar rig gnas kyi 'byung khungs rang cag bod yul nas 'bab pa'i chu klung 'di dag yin pa nga tsho'i gzi bajid gcig ma red dam/rgya gar ba tshos gna' deng gnyis kar gangs te se ni tshangs pa'i pho brang ngam 'dzam gling chu'i 'byung khungs yin par bshad nas gnas bskor dang dad gus byed pa'ang rgyu mtshan de yis yin par 'dod/gna' bo'i dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab bzhi'i nang gras kyi rgya nag rig gnas kyang rma chu dang 'bri chus skyed par 'dzam gling yongs kyis mtha' gcig tu smra zhing / zhib mor bshad na/ rang yul gyi ba yan ha ri'i shar ngos nas 'bab pa'i chu klung rma chu sngon mos rgya nag byang shar rig gnas dang / ba yan ha ri'i lho ngos nas 'bab pa'i chu klung chen po 'bri chus rgya nag lho nub rig gnas skyed pa yin pa kun la gsal ba ltar red/rang mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'phro ba'i rig gnas skyed pa po'am yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu klung chen po yar klung gtsang po ni rang yul gyi ri bo hi ma la ya'i byang rgyud kyi bye ma g.yung drung zhes pa'i gangs ri las bzhur nas mthar rgya gar du 'bab kyi yod/ 'dzam gling steng ches ring zhing ming du grags pa'i yar klung gtsang po'i gcong rong yang der chags yod/ ring tshad spyi le 200lhag tsam yod la/ mtsho ngos mtho tshad smi 2800tsam nas de mur smi 500tsam du zab par chags yod/ cha snyoms dma' tshad 10 3phro tsam yin la/ chu'i mgyogs tshad skar cha rer smi 8tsam 'bab kyi 'dug chu glog khang gis zhib rtsis byas bar chu nus thon khungs phal cher wa(spo)stong phrag khri 7000tsam yin pas/ chu glog bzo grwa sogs bzo bar 'dzam gling yongs su rang byung du ma grub shing tshan rtsal gyis kyang skrun thabs med pa'i rang byung thon khungs bla na 20

med pa zhig yin/da dung de dag dang phal cher cha 'dra ba'i chu klung chen po shin tu mang ste/dper na/ zla chu dang rgyal mo rngul chu/ glang chen kha 'bab/ seng ge kha 'bab/rdza chu/ tshwa 'dam chu bo/ 'brug chu/ klu chu/ dme chu/ bsang chu/ rdo gzhung gtsang po/ myang chu/ nyang chu/ yar klung gtsang po/ rtsa skya gtsang po/ g.yu 'brug gtsang po/ 'bog tshang gtsang po/ mtsho la gtsang po/ wa mo gtsang po/kha 'thung gtsang po/ skya chu/ brag gtsang po sogs dwangs shing gtsang la/ dri mas ma sbag pa/ nya sram dang rin po che'i rigs ha cang mang po dang bcas 'bab te/ 〈 yar lung chos 'byung 〉 du ‘‘chu bo gang ga ni shar nas brag glang po che'i kha 'dra ba nas dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas te shar phyogs kyi rgya mtshor 'bab bo/ lho nas sisnu ni brag khyu mchog gi kha 'dra ba nas baiṭārya'i bye ma 'dren cing chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas te lho phyogs kyi rgya mtshor 'bab bo/ nub nas dpag bru brag rta'i kha 'dra ba nas shel gyi bye ma 'dren cing chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas te byang phyogs kyi rgya mtshor 'bab bo//byang nas si ta brag seng ge'i kha 'dra ba nas gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas te byang phyogs kyi rgya mtshor 'bab bo//’’zhes gsal/mi lo stong phrag mang po'i dar rgud kyi 'od stong rnam par 'phro bzhin pa'i mi rigs 'ga'i rig gnas lo rgyus 'di ltar yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu klung 'di dag gi bzhur rgyun las brdol ba sus kyang snyon thabs med la/ dri med dwangs gtsang gi rlabs phreng chal chil 'phyo bzhin pa'i chu klung 'di dag kyang gangs ri'i ra ba'i ldebs ngos so so nas mdzad mtha' med pa'i tshul gyi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du 'bab kyi yod pa mngon sum tshad ma yin zhing / da 21

lta'ang da dung mu mthud du mdzad mtha' med pa'i tshul gyis 'bab min sus kyang thag gcod dka' bar 'dod/ lhag par du mi'i rigs kyi grangs 'bor mang du 'phel ba dang / thon skyed nus tshad gong du 'phel bar bstun nas zhing phyugs log gnyer dang / nags tshal log gcod/ spangs thang log spyod byed pa'i gnas tshul tshab che bas/ rang byung chu'i thon tshad je nyung dang /sa'i rlon tshad je dma' / (dper na/ ‘‘mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi chu'i 'dus tshad lo rer 23phro nyung du 'gro bzhin yod ces gsal ba ltar red’’)rtsi shing skye nus je zhan (dper na/ ‘‘nag chu sa khul 'khyags sa'i spang khug (thopi)dang 'khyags sa'i rtswa thang gi rtswa'i cha snyoms thon tshad lo rabs 60pa'i spyi ching (1〉lo)re'i spyi rgya 2760dang spyi ching re'i spyi rgya 1175de lo rabs 90pa'i spyi ching re'i spyi rgya 1107dang spyi ching re'i spyi rgya 511 tsam du snyoms por mar chags 'dug 50—60lko tsam nyung du phyin 'dug’’sogs su 'gro bzhin yod pa ma zad/ gangs ri'i khangs mtshams je mtho dang / lung gzhung 'khyags dar je chung / mtsho dang mtshe'u je nyung (dper na/ ‘‘1994lo nas rma chu'i 'byung khungs su gyur ba'i mtsho sngo ring gi (kṣaṣṭha oṃ)chu'i tshad smi 1 5—2bar mar chags 'dug’’)ljang nem spangs ljongs je dkon/ (dper na/ ‘‘lo rer rgyal yongs kyi sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma7460tsam sa rgod du 'gyur gyi 'dug la/shang kang (ndeṭha)gi sa khyon gyi ldab gnyis red/ bod ljongs sa khyon gyi ṭwāṃgi skyed nus shor 'dug la/ de'i nang gi 50phro tsam tshabs chen red/ 10phro tsam gyi bye sa ngo mar 'gyur 'dug mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi skyed nus shor ba dang bye sar gyur ba'i sa khyon gyis spyi ching 733tsam zin 'dug de ni rtswa sa yongs kyi 19phro tsam red/ rnga ba khul gyi rtswa thang bye sar gyur ba'i rgya khyon lo rabs 5022

ba'i mu'u khri 1nas mu'u khri 7lhag tu 'phar snon byung 'dug’rdo thang bye thang je che/ chu mdzod je mang / (dper na/ ‘1990lo'i bar rma chu'i bzhur yul du chu mdzod che 'bring chung gsum 3147bzos 'dug’’)zhing rwa dang grong sde/ rgya lam sogs kyi 'dam shur grog rong je zab/ sngon chad mdzad mtha' med pa'i tshul gyi 'bab pa'i chu klong chen po rma chu dang 'bri chur bzhur rgyun chad pa'i gnas tshul 'byung gi 'dug (dper na/ ‘1972lo nas rma chur bzhur rgyun chad pa'i gnas tshul byung zhing / 1972lo nas 1997lo'i bar gyi lo 26gi nang du/ rma chu'i stod smad gnyis nas bzhur rgyun thengs 20chad 'dug lo rabs 90ba nas lo ltar bzhur rgyun chad kyi 'dug 1998lor ring tshad spyi le 700lhag gi bzhur rgyun bar chad byung 'dug lhag par du 1996lo dang 1999lo gnyis la rma chu'i 'byung khungs te da da rma stod nas thengs gnyis la bzhur rgyun chad 'dug’’)rang byung chu mdzod la'ang mdzad mtha' yod pa ma zad/bod gangs can nam mi'i rigs kyi mdun du lhag pa'i 'jig nyen tshabs chen zhig gi gsal brda'am sngon brda red snyam pa zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes byung // lnga/ bod yul gyi mtsho dang mtshe'u/ bod yul du nam mkha' thang la lhung ba lta bu'i mtsho dang mtshe'u ha cang mang po yod/ bod yongs kyi mtsho dang mtshe'u'i rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 23800lhag yin la/ des rgyal yongs mtsho dang mtshe'u'i rgya khyon gyi 30phrotsam zin yod/ bsdoms brtsis byas bar gzhig na/ bod yongs la mtsho dang mtshe'u che chung 1500lhag tsam yod/ de las gnam mtsho phyug mo dang / ser gling mtsho/ bkra ri gnam mtsho gsum gyi rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 1000las brgal yod la/ rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma 123

re'i cha snyoms kyi ldab 3 yin/ nags tshal gyi gsog tshad smi gru bzhi ma khri dung phyir 14 dang stong phrag 3600yin/ rgyal yongs mi re'i cha snyoms gsog tshad kyi ldab 70dang / 'dzam gling mi re'i cha snyoms gsog tshad kyi ldab 11 yin/bod yul gyi nags gter gtso bo lho kha dang lha sa/ chab mdo sogs hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud dang 'phred rgyug ri rgyud du yod/ de las chab mdo'i nags tshal gyi ljongs yongs sa khyon gyi 28 7phro dang / lha sa'i nags tshal rgya khyon gyis lha sa grong khyer yongs kyi sa khyon gyi ṭwāṃdang / lho kha'i nags tshal gyis lho kha sa khul yongs kyi rgya khyon gyi 26 8phro zin yod/ da dung si khron zhing chen nags tshal gyi ṭwāṃde dkar mdzes dang rnga ba khul gnyis su yod la/ kan su'u kan lho khul yongs rgya khyon gyi brgya cha'i 22 8 tsam nags tshal gyis bzung yod/ dpa' ris bod rigs rang skyong rdzong khongs su'ang rang byung nags tshal mu'u khri 249 tsam yod/ gzhan yang mtsho sngon dang yun nan bde chen bcas su'ang rgya khyon shin tu che ba'i nags tshal yod par thos/nags de dag tshang ma rang byung nags tshal yin pa dang / nags rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ skye sla ba/ rgyu spus bzang ba/ dpal 'byor nags rigs mang ba sogs kyi khyad chos ldan pas/ 'di yang rang byung dpal 'byor thon khungs rtsa chen zhig yin pa su yis bsnyon thub/ bdun/ bod yul gyi gter kha/ bod yul du gter rdzas ha cang 'dzoms po yod/ da bar shes rtogs byung ba'i gter rdzas rigs 100lhag yod par gsal/ de las bod rang skyong ljongs gcig pu'i kā gter (lko)gsog tshad kyis rgyal yongs kā gter gsog tshad kyi 50phro lhag zin yod pa ma zad/ rgyal yongs su go gnas gal chen yod pa'i zangs (ma)dang / zha 25

nye(lko) dngul (kṇiṣṭha) gser (nt+ra) mtsho tshwa (lo༅) rdo bal (rmyo.oṃ) rdo snum (rkotshe)sogs lcags gshis gter rdzas mang bo dang / tshwa mtsho'i nang gi ca tshwa(stisto〉khri)dang / tshwa la (skyotshe)rmā (sbyiji)bcas rgyal yongs ma zad/ 'dzam gling yongs la dkon pa'i gter kha'i thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod/da dung gzi (ṣṭha5ṣṭharmyo)dang / khra man (7྾lko)/ khyung skyug nal sogs mi bzhu ba'i khams kyi rin po che'i gter dang / lcags (ṣṭha)dang / zha nye(tshe/)ha yang (sa)rno (tshe'u)sogs bzhu ba'i khams kyi rin po che'i rigs/khab chen sogs bzhu ba'i khams kyi rdo gter dang / sbal rgyab (04skyobo)dang /gangs thig (au4sturmyo)rdo sol (lko)yugs (lko7)lhang tsher (skyastse)mthing rgyus (khatshoskye73)sogs mi bzhu ba'i khams kyi rdo rigs sogs kyi gter kha che phra dpag tu med pa mdo dbus khams gsum su khyab yod/brgyad/ bod yul gyi srog chags dang rtsi shing / bod yul gyi skye dngos rigs ha cang mang po yod/ bod rang skyong ljongs gcig pur mtshon na/mtho rim skye dngos rigs 6000lhag tsam yod/ de'i nang dpal 'byor rin thang ldan zhing / dgos gal che ba'i rigs 1000lhag tsam yod/ da bar shes rtogs zin pa'i 'bru rigs 2305lhag dang / nya rigs 44 lhag skam chu gnyis 'tsho'i rigs44lhag gog bgrod rigs 51 lhag bya rigs 48lhag nu 'thung rigs 118lhag bcas yod/ gsham du rtsa che ba'i rigs kyi ming tsam bkod na/ 'dzam gling gi yul gzhan du dkon pa'i sman rigs la/hong len dang / bong dkar/ sro lo/ g.ya' gyi ma/ gang ga chung / bya rgod sug pa/ dpa' bo dkar ser / spang rgyan me tog utpal/ lug mig tsher sngon/ stag sha ug chos/ lug ru/ kyi lce/ shang dril/ me tog ser chen/ 26

gzhan zhing las dang phyugs las gnyis las bod du dar snga shos gang yin zhe na/ zhing las snga ba yod de rgyu mtshan 'di'am phyugs las 'phyi ba'i dpang rtags 'di zhes bden lugs rachad rgyu sus kyang dka' bar 'dod/ rgyu mtshan ni rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas ba su zhig yin yang gna' shul rdo chas sam gna' gzhung gtam rgyud re rtsa bar bzung nas rigs 'ded byed dgos pa las ya thog spyi tshogs kyi rgan po mgo dkar zhig gam zin bris dpe gzhung zhig yod mi srid pa'o/ de'i phyir/ deng rabs zhib 'jug pa la las kha rub sogs nas thon pa'i gna' shul du zhing las lag cha mang shos 'dug pas bod du zhing las dar snga shos 'dug zhes u tshugs mtha' 'khyongs byed pa dang /la las kyang rgyu mtshan gzhan pa re drangs nas bod du 'brog las thog mar dar zer ba sogs mang po byung 'dug mod/ 'on kyang kho bos bsam blo btang gin btang gin de dag gang du'ang mi gtogs pa zhig 'dod kyi yod/ gna' dang por byung ba'i mi rnams ni thog mar sa cha'am yul lung gcig nas byung yod pa las phyogs so so nas mnyam gcig tu byung yod pa mi 'dod la/ grangs tshad kyang rim bzhin 'phel yod pa las khri 'bum mang po lhan gcig tu byung yod pa de las kyang dpe mi srid/ de bas/ khong tsho'i nye 'khor gyi ma rmos lo tog dang ri dwags tsho rim par nyung du phyin pa'am med par gyur ba dang gcig rang rigs grangs tshad 'phel ba dang gnyis kyis rgyu mtshan byas nas phyogs so sor ma rmos lo tog dang ri dwags 'tshol bar 'khyams yod pa las ma rmos lo tog sogs mdzad pa dang chabs cig glo bur 'bru rigs 'debs shes ba dang phyugs rigs bkug shes med par 'dod/ de ltar 'khyams skabs nags tshal che sa dang gnam gshis dro khul du ri dwags dang lo tog kyang mang bo yod srid 39

cing / kho tshos ri dwags rnams kyang sa mtho sa'am nags tshal med sar bros 'ded byas yod srid/ de'i phyir/ 'khyags shing mtho la ri dwags mang pa'i sgang gzhung dag du rngon par phyin pa'i mi skor zhig gis sgo phyugs skyong shes ba dang / dro zhing dma' la lo tog mang sar lus pa'i mi skor zhig gis zhing las gnyer shes nas zhing phyugs las rigs phal cher dus mnyam du byung yod pa min nam snyam gyi yod/ sa bcad gsum pa/ gna' rabs bod kyi shes rig dpal 'byor/de yang〈 deb ther dmar po〉las ‘‘ma rmos lo tog rnams rim par byung /de zos pas pho mo'i dbang bo dod de 'khrig pa spyod pa byung / de'i tshe ngo tsha skyob pa la khang pa byung ngo / lo thog de la sog 'jog dang dbang ris med cing /nam dgos dus su len ’’ces dang〈 mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉 du ‘‘ma rmos 'bru za gos su shing lo gyon’’zhes gsungs ba ltar ya thog bod mis ma rmos lo tog kyang ma tshar gong nas khang ba bzo ba dang 'bru rigs gsog 'jog byed pa/ gos su shing lo gyon pa sogs kyang shes yod/ yang gong du bshad pa'i kha rub dang chu kong / nag chu sogs nas thon pa'i gna' shul dag la dpyad naya thog bod du ches ma mtha' yang spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo ngo sum stong yar sngon nas rdo brtsigs dang sa dong brkos te bzo bkod legs pa'i khang ba zur gsum/gru bzhi/ zlum po sogs bzo ba dang / zhing phyugs rngon gsum la nyer mkho'i lag char rtsub brdar gtubs gsum byas pa'i snying bu/ kha ba/ sta re/ rus leb sog le'i kha can/ ra snyung sogs rus chas dang / sbyag ma/ 'jor/ 40

gshol/ mdung rtse/ mda' rtse sogs kyi rdo chas/ thab rdo gsum can gyi sgyed pu dang khog ma/ sla nga / phor ba sogs kyi rdza chas sogs skabs de dang bsdur na bzo rtsal mtho ba mang po dar yod pa ma zad/ ya mtshar dgos ba zhig la rdo dang yang ṭi/ rus pa sogs kyis byas pa'i skra gzer dang mo kor/ rna long /phreng ris/ mgul rgyan/ phrul phrul/ mgron bu bcas rgyan cha'i rigs kyang mang bo byung yod pa sus kyang byas pa tsam ma yin par kun gyi mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du gyur yod pa 'di rang red/de yang〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉(shog ngos 151)du lo rgyus chen mo sogs las/dang po gnod sbyin nag po zhes bya ba byung ste//yul ming bzang yul rgyan med bya bar btags//lag char mda' gzhu 'phen pa de nas byung //gnyiṭa/ pa re lde mgo g.yag bdud kyis byas//yul gyi ming yang bdud yul gling dgu zer//sta re dgra sta dus der lag char byung //gsum pa gnya' ring phrag med srin gyis byas//yul gyi ming yang nag po dgu dul zer//lag char srin mo rkang dang skyogs gnyis byung //bzhi ba dmar 'jam zhes bya lha yis byas//yul gyi ming ni lha yul gung thang zer//lag char kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum de nas byung //drug pa krog krog 'dre yis dbang byas ste// 41

lang tang ling tang bar kha 'ur rdo 'phen//bdun pa ma sangs rus dgus dbang byas ste//yul gyi ming ni bod khams g.yang drug zer//lag char dong ral phub chung de nas byung //brgyad pa klus dbang byas bod khams gling dgur btags//dgu ba mi ma yin gyis dbang byas te//yul gyi ming ni ngam yul nag por btags//bcu po 'gong po spun dgus dbang byas te//yul gyi ming yang stong sde bco brgyad zer’’zhes gsungs pa ltar bod yul du bskal ba ya thog gi mi ma yin gyi spyi tshogs su gnod sbyin dang / bdud/srin po/ lha/ 'dre/ ma sangs/ klu mi ma yin sogs kyi dbang bsgyur res 'khor byed skabs nas rdo dang rus pa'i lag cha 'ga' re byung yod pa gong gsal ltar red/ lhag par du dgra sta dang skyogs sogs kyang byung yod par bsam na/ skabs de dus nas sems can rigs mi 'dra ba de dag gi bar du rgyun par 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod 'byung gi yod pa shugs su gsal/de nas gong du smos pa ltar smra shes shing don go ba/ blo rig gsal zhing khyad par ba'i shes yon dang khyad chos mang po mchis pa'i mi'i rigs thog mar byung ba rim bzhin mang du 'phel nas rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis dang /rgyal phran bzhi bcu byung / da dung 〈 g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 'byung phyogs bsdus/ 〉las ‘‘dus rabs de bzhi'i (ma sangs spun dgu dang / za rams skyes drug rgyal phran bcu gnyis/ rgyal phran sil ma bzhi bcu bzhi/)ring la rim bzhin du lcags rigs rnyed cing / rdo bzo shing gcod shes/ spu breg thag 42

tshems zhing 'debs sogs shes dus/ 'brog dang yul ba zhes pa'i srid pa byung /’’zhes gsungs pa ltar mi'i rigs kyis shes rig lag rtsal thog mar spel 'go brtsams/ da dung bod yul du sa skyes rdo skyes kyi chos lugs zab mo bon chos gsar gtod mkhan ston pa gshen rab mi bo che'ang dus rabs 'di'i nang du 'khrungs ba yin/ khong gis bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dar spel dang yi ge gsar bzo/ spyi tshogs bsgyur bkod sogs ji ltar mdzad pa dang /skabs 'dir bod kyi shes rig chu tshad gang 'dra zhig tu slebs yod pa dag khong gi mdzad rnam dang dpe gzhung gzhan du gzigs par zhu/ yang 〈 tun hong gter yig〉las ‘‘rgyal phran yul yul na/ mkhar bu re re gnaste’’zhes byung bar dpyad na/ skabs der rgyal phran so sos bzo rtsal dang stobs 'byor 'gran rtsod byed pa'i dmigs pas/ bod yul du yul lung so sor mkhar dang khang ba bzo skrun bya ba'i mtho rlabs zhig kyang bslangs yod par 'dod/sa bcad bzhi ba/ gna' rabs bod kyi tshong las dpal 'byor/de yang ‘‘g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 'byung phyogs bsdus’’las/‘‘bod yul ma sangs spun dgus dbang byas te//yul ming bod khams gzhung drug ces su grags//snga rtags mda' mdung mtshon cha rtse ba dang //bzhon pa zhon dang dngos po nyo tshong byung //’’zhes gsungs bar bsam na/yul sde so so'i thon skyed dngos rdzas rnams rta g.yag gi zhon pa spyad nas phan tshun bar du 'gro 'ong byas te/ brje spor byed pa'i tshong las rnam pa'ang byung 4phyi

yod tshod red/ yin na'ang / skabs 'di'i mi rnams kyis phan tshun gyi dgos mkho ltar rang rang gi ngal rtsol las thon pa'i dngos po rnams nyo tshong byed kyi yod pa las tshong las rkyang rkyang gi khe spog la khen nas 'tsho ba skyel ba'i tshong mkhan nam/ tshong sde byung yod par mi 'dod/ 'on kyang / tshong gnyer las rigs 'di'i myong tshor gyis spyi tshogs su tshong gnyer las rigs dngos su byung bar mi rnams kyi bsam blo dang / 'grim 'grul/ dngos po'i rgyu chas sogs gang ci'i thad nas rmang gzhi brtan po bting yod pa smos med red/ de nas rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis sam rgyal phran bzhi bcu'i dus su bod du tshong gnyer ched las byung yod pa ma zad/ tshong nyer dpung sde chags te/ spyi tshogs las rigs zhig tu chags nas bod kyi tshong las 'thus sgo tshang zhing / 'phel rgyas chen po phyin te/ spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho skong bar phan nus chen po 'don gyi yod ste/ 〈 rgyal rabs gser gyi phreng ba 〉las ‘‘tshong 'dus bcu gnyis nas nor gyi dbyig 'bul’’zhes gsungs yod pas so/ 44

le'u gsum pa/ bod btsan po'i dus rabs kyi dpal 'byor/sa bcad dang po/ phyugs las dpal 'byor/ spyir bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po yar sngon nas bod du bskal ba ya thog gi thun mong spyi tshogs mjug sgril nas bran g.yog lam lugs dar rgyas chen po phyin yod pa ma zad/ bod spyi tshogs kyi gral rim dang sde shog rgyal phran so so'i bar gyi 'gal zla'ang rno ngar can du gyur yod/ gnya' khri byung rjes/rgyal phran bzhi bcu sogs rang gi mnga' khongs su bsdus nas bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs thog mar dbu brnyes pa yin pas/ bod kyi spyi tshogs zhi 'jags su gyur zhing srid 'byor rig gsum sogs phyogs gang thad du dar spel rgya cher byung yod/ rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i skabs su/ ‘‘lo ngam rta rdzi’’dang / ‘‘khyi mo gnyan gyi rna gsang ma bya ba'i sprul ba'i khyi gcig’mi‘‘glang dmar po la thal sgro bkal’’ces sogs kyi tshig gsal bas/ rta rdzi dang lug rdzi/ zog rdzi sogs phyugs rigs khag bgos las sna dar rgyas chen po byung yod pa mtshon thub la/ru khyim gnas spo dang tshong las skyel 'dren/ 'thab dmag rgyang bskyod sogs byed skabs kyang rta g.yag dag la khal 'gel ba'i srol byung yod/ da dung khyi sogs kyang sgo phyugs su bkug nas rngon rgyag pa'am dmag 'thab byed pa la'ang bkol spyod kyi nus pa chen po 'don gyi yod pa gsal po red/ pu de gong rgyal yab sras kyi sku ring la/ g.yag dang ba glang sogs dud 'gro rnams zhing las rmo 'debs byed par yang bkol shes kyi yod pa gsal/ lha tho tho 45

ri'i ring du 'o ma las mar len tshul shes 'dug rgyal po stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi dus su glang dang 'bri'am/ g.yag dang ba mo/ rta dang bong ma/rgod ma dang bong bu sogs kyi rigs mi 'dra ba'i phyugs rnams bsdebs pa las mdzo dang / drel sogs rigs dang / rgyu ba/ bkol spyod rin thang sogs ci yang mi 'dra ba'i dud 'gro'i rigs gzhan pa 'byung ba shes nas phyugs las thon skyed gong 'phel chen po byung yod pa ma zad/ mar gyi tshong byed tshul yang dar yod/ rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan dang srong btsan sgom po yab sras kyi ring la/ 〈 bka' chem ka khol ma 〉las ‘‘'brong pho mo ni g.yag dang 'bri ru gtul// sha ba pho mo ni ba glang du btul// rgo ba pho mo ni lug tu btul//rkyang pho mo ni rta ru btul// spyang pho mo ni khyi ru btul// rmo bkol so nam de'i dus na byas// phyugs kyi rdzi skyong yang de'i dus na byung ’’zhes 'khod 'dug par dpyad na/ sngar gyi phyugs las rmang gzhi'i khar/ gcan gzan ri dwags kyi rigs gzhan pa'ang sgo phyugs su bgug cing / phyugs rigs kyi grangs 'bor tshad med 'phel rgyas phyin pas/ sngar las zhib tshags ldan pa'i 'bangs rdzi bdun sogs kyi las ming dbye ste/ phyugs rigs 'tsho skyong dang bdag nyer byed stangs mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas byung yod pa ma zad/ 〈 la dwags rgyal rabs su〉‘‘zas kyi yo byad tshang ba/ 'o ma zho ru bsgyur ba/ zho la mar dang da ra/ da ra thud du bsgyur ba’’zhes gsal bas/ phyug las thon skyed lag rtsal yang dar spel chen po byung nas bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong bar phan nus chen po thebs kyi yod tshod red/ btsan po mang srong mang btsan gyi skabs su/ lugs paṭa kyis slog pa bzo ba dang lug bal gyis phying bu bzo ba/ khul rtsid kyi sbra bzo ba sogs kyang shes 'dug ste 〈 thang 46

bod lo rgyus〉su ‘‘dbyar dus su bal gyi phying pa dang / dgun ni slog pa gyon te lung khug tu babs nas sbra nag dang spyil bu phugs te sdod’’zhes gsungs bas so/sa bcad gnyis pa/ zhing las dpal 'byor/ de yang〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉 du ‘‘bod la 'phrul blon mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi//thog mar gyur ba ru las skyes 'di yin//mdzangs ba'i las su shing bsregs srol ba byung //de yis rdo bzhu gser dngul zangs lcags phyung //shing la mig phug gshol dang gnya' shing byas/sa gzhi brkos nas phu chu yur du drangs/rmon pa dor bsdebs spang thang zhing du rmos//brgal ba'i mi thar chu la zam pa btsugs//rmos pa'i lo tog thog mar 'di nas byung //’’zhes gsal bar dpyad na/bod rgyal dgu ba pu de gong rgyal gyi sku ring la/ zhing las thon skyed kyi yo byad mang po gsar du byung ba'am sngar gyi rdo chas sogs thabs chag gi yo byad rnams la bzo bcos rgya cher mdzad pa dang / gshin sa'am spang thang mang po zhing sar bzos pa ma zad/ lhag par du rka lam dang yur ba mang po brkos nas zhing sar chu drangs ba sogs sngar byung ma myong zhing / tshan rig rang bzhin ldan pa'i zhing las thon skyed lam lugs dar spel btang te/ bod kyi zhing las thon skyed go rim gsar ba zhig tu bskyal yod pa 'dra/ ‘‘rmos pa'i lo tog thog 47

mar 'di nas byung ’’zhes ba bod spyi la khyab brdal byung ba'am rgyal bo'i mdzod sogs su gsog gnyer byas pa'i rmos 'bru byung ba dang / yang na zhing las rmo 'debs kyi las rigs thad mdzad rjes che ba'i blon po'i che ba brjod de gzhan la skul ma gtong phyir dmigs dpe ston pa'am bka' drin rjes su dran ched snga ma'i las kyang 'og mar bsdus ba sogs su go dgos ba las/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog tu rgyal bo 'di'i sngon du zhing las dar med pa min pa gong du'ang bshad zin la/ gnya' khri'i skabs su byung bar grags pa'i yum bu bla sgang gi nub 'dabs su bod spyi gzhung gi thog ma'i zhing sa da lta dngos su yod pa tsam gyis kyang mtshon thub/de nas bod rgyal bcu ba e sho legs kyis dus su//‘‘de yi blon po lha bu mgo dkar zhes//khu khu ru las skyes pa'i bu yis byas//'phrul blon mdzangs mi mdun gyi gnyis pa yin//'brog la thul rtsis phu chu yur du drangs//mda' ru chu ma rmo ba 'di nas dar//’’zhes byung bas/ yab mes tsho'i mdzad rjes bzang po'i rmang gzhi'i thog lung mdo 'am lung gzhung sogs kyi gshin sa yod rgu zhing sar bzos brjes / zhib tshags chen pos zhing sa khag bgos byas ba'i bar bar du dor kha brtsegs pa ma zad/ lung ba'i phugs su chu mdzod bzos te/ yur rka brgyud nas zhing sar drangs bas/ zhing las thon skyed 'phel rgyas chen po btang yod par 'dod//‘‘rgyal po khri snyan bzung btsan gyi ring la/ mtsho la star ka byas nas/yur bur drangs ba dang / phu chu rdzing du bskyil nas/ mtshan chu nyin la drangs ’’ 48

zhes〈 la dwags rgyal rabs 〉su gsal ba ltar zhing las 'phel rgyas la phan pa'i byed thabs mang po spel cing / zhing las dar spel gtong ba'i las mgul gnyis ba bslangs zhes smra mkhan yod/gnam ri srong btsan yab sras kyi ring la zhing las thon skyed rgya cher spel yod srid de/ 〈 lde'u chos 'byung 〉las‘‘'brog thul gyis bgos/ zhing the gus bcal’’zhes dang / ‘‘cha mi khyim brgya yis zhing rmod tha rgod 'dul’’zhes dang /srong btsan gyis gtan 'bebab byas pa'i khyim sna lnga las‘‘'bro bza'i khrims bu chung ni/ skyes ba la phag slob/ bza' ma la mo phyag slob/ phyug yong ba'i rtsa ba zhing la rmu rdo btsugs/ ston dpyid kyi spar kha mnyam’’zhes dang / thang rgyal rabs la dpe blangs nas zhing la rgyal zhing dang / blon zhing / 'babs zhing /bon zhing sogs su dbye nas khral bsdu ba'i lam lugs gtan 'bebs byas pa sogs mdor na zhing phyugs kyi las bgos khrims kyis phye ba/ sa rgod 'dul ba dang chu mdzod bskyil ba'i las ka rgya cher spel cing / sa zhing gi che chung brtsi ba'i tshad gzhi gsar du bzos ba sogs bod kyi zhing las thon skyed la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i bcos bsgyur mang du mdzod pas/ dus skabs de'i stobs 'byor mnga' thang tshad mthon por slebs yod/rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su dbyar dus su smyug rtswa sogs 'debs 'dzugs byas te/ skam nas dgun nam dpyid dus su phyugs rigs sha shed ngan pa dag gso thabs sam skyong gnyor byed pa'i srol yang dar yod de/‘‘stag btsan gdon gzigs blon gnyer gyi bus//mdzangs ba'i las su dbyar rtsa dgun du skams//mdzangs mi bdun las tha ma ba ru grags//’’zhes gsal bas so/ mdor na/ 49

pur rgyal btsan po'i skabs kyi zhing las thon skyed dar rgyas chen po byung yod pa bod mi khri phrag mang po mtha' bzhir dmag tu bskyod skabs zas 'bru chad sdug byung tshul gcig kyang mi gsal ba tsam las mtshon thub par snyam/sa bcad gsum pa gsum pa/ bzo las dpal 'byor/de yang〈 deb ther dmar po〉las/ ‘‘rje gnya' khri btsan po nyid kyis yul yar klung sog khar byon te/ pho brang yum bu bla mkhar brtsigs pa bod kyi pho brang gi snga shos su 'dug’’ces gsal ba ltar bod rje thog ma gnya' khri btsan pos bzo skrun mdzad cing / da lta da dung nga tsho'i mig gi dga' ston du spyod chog pa'i pho brang dang po yum bu bla sgang gi bzo bkod tsam gyis skabs de'i bod kyi lag shes bzo las byas tshad ji 'dra zhig tu thon yod pa rang rang gis rig 'ded byas chog yin na'ang / pho brang ni rgyal po bzhugs gnas dang /mkhar ni blon 'bangs phal ba 'tsho sdod byed sa yin pa'i khyad par 'byed dgos ba las yum bu bla sgang la thog ma'i pho brang gi ming mi 'jug pa nges dgos so//de nas gnam gyi khri bdun dang / stod kyi steng gnyis/ sa yi legs drug gi ring du rim bzhin gsas mkhar kho ma ne'u chung dang / kho ma yongs rtse/dgu ra dgu 'khyud/ zo bo khong lag g.yung drung lha rtse/ sa le byel tshal/ lo ngam rta rdzi'i mkhar myang ro sham po/ 'phying ba rtse drug stag rtse/ rgod rtse/yang rtse/ khri rtse/ rtse mo khyung rgyal/ khri brtsigs 'bum gdugs sogs bzo bkod legs pos yid kyi brtan pa cig car du 'phrog nus pa'i mkhar dang khang ba mang po byung bar bshad/ gzhan〈 rgyal rabs gser gyi phreng ba 〉las/50

‘‘mdzangs sna lnga gser g.yu dang yig tshang gis bstod/ dpa' sna lnga seng ge dang gong stag gis brgyan’’ces byung bas/ phur rgyal gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs su gser dngul zangs lcags rnams bzhu 'don byed pa'i lag rtsal tshad mthor slebs yod par sems/ pu de gung rgyal gyi dus su/ ko ba bzhu ba'i snying po sbyin dang / chu che chung la zam pa 'dzugs srol sogs kyang dar ba ma zad/ zhing las thon skyed lag rtsal dang gser dngul lcags bzhu'i lag rtsal yang rgya cher dar yod pa mdzangs blon gnyis ba'i phyag rjes tsam las kyang rtogs thub stabs/ bod spyi tshogs dpal 'byor la gsar brje thog dang por byung zhes lab chog chog yin par 'dod/rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan gyi ring la/ ‘‘tshe spong gi ri la gser rnyed/ge ri'i brag la dngul rnyed/ 'phreng ba'i rdza la zangs rnyed/ ra ga'i ri la lcags rnyed/ byang gi bla mtsho la tshwa rnyed ’’zhes pa sogs la dpyad na/ sngar las lhag pa'i lag rtsal 'phel rgyas phyin te/ mtho ba ri las dma' ba rgya mjo'i bar gyi gter kha mang po sngog 'don byas te/ (gter 'don mtho rlabs gnyis ba bslangs zer mkhan yang yod/) bod spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dar spel gyi kha phyogs rim pa gsar ba zhig tu bskyal yod par sems/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku che'i stod du/ lho rgya gar dang bal bo/nub stag gzig byang li yul/ shar rgya nag sogs la btsan gnyen gyis 'brel ba btsugs shing / shes rig bsgyur 'dren gyi mtho rlabs thog dang por bslangs pa ma zad/ deng rabs tshan rtsal las kyang thon par dka' ba'i pho brang po ta la dang gtsug lag khang rnam gnyis sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi bcu lhag bzo skrun byas pa gsal/ da dung thon mi 51

gtsos blo ldan pa mang po yi ge dang / lag shes bzo las/ chos/ rig gnas sogs slob tu ched bskos mi sna phyi rgyal du phar bkod 'doms byas pa dang /〈 thang yig rnying ma〉las ‘‘dar 'bu gso mkhan dang chang ma/ rdo bzo/ shog snag la sogs pa bzo mkhan mngags dgos tshul zhus pa ltar/ gong mas kyang de ltar gnang ’’zhes gsal ba ltar phyi rgyal gyi ched mkhas ba mang po bod du tshur drangs ba ma zad/ bod nang khul du'ang gar g.yo gar mkhan dang gar ru sga mkhan/ srags gzhu mkhan/ ra shag mda' mkhan/ bya ba khrab man/ tshong rdzi/lham mkhan te bzo las khag drug bod spyi tshogs la mkho ba'i thon rdzas 'don bzo byed pa'i bzo grwa mang po thog mar btsugs shing / mi rigs rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i 'khel 'thag dang / mdzes ris/ sbyar brkos/ gshangs brkos/gser tshag dngul tshag lcags tshag rdza bzo/ rang 'thag chu yis bskor ba/chu la gru gtong ba sogs kyi lag shes bzo rtsal 'phel rgyas rgya cher btang mod/sku che'i smad tsam du sangs rgyas chos lugs sgrub sbyong gi las la 'bad nas bod kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor nyams rgud du gyur ba'am sngar gnas su lus ba/ do dam zhib tshags ma thon pa lta bu'i 'gyur ldog yid phangs ba zhig byung med dam snyam gyi yod/ gang ltar/ bod spyi tshogs dar spel gyi kha phyogs de rig gnas can du bsgyur gnang mdzad yod pa thag chog red/ yang rgya gar dang / bal bo/li yul/ rgya nag sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab stobs ldan rnams la btsan 'dzul pham pa med pa byas yod tshul la dpyad na/ skabs der mda' gzhu dang /gri mdung tsam ma yin par sngon thon can gyi drag chas rigs gzhan re bzo ba'i lag rtsal shes rig kyang dar med dam bsam rgyu 'dugagazhan yang khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bus//52

mdzangs pa'i las su ri khyim klungs su pham/spo mtho mkhar du brtsegs nas grong khyer bcos//'di yan bod kyi khang khyim ri la yod//de phyir bod kyi mdzangs mi lnga ba yin’’zhes 'dug pas/ srong btsan sogs yar lung nas lha sar spos ba tsam ma yin par/ blon 'bangs phal cher khang khyim du gnas bca' ba'i srol byung zhing / bod spyi tshogs grong khyer gyi rnam pa can du sdod yod pa zhig min nam snyam gyi yod/ khri lde gtsug brtan gyi skabs su'ang brag dmar ka ru dang / kha cher 'brin bzangs/ lha sa kha braga'aphyin bu rnam ral/ mang gong gi lha khang lnga bzhengs nas sman dang chos bsgyur spel byed par 'bad/ khri srong sde btsan gyi sku ring la/ ‘‘bsam yas gtsug lag khang de mkhar gting bod kyi lugs su byas/ mkhar dkyil (sked)rgya nag gi lugs su byas/ mkhar rtse (thog)rgya gar gyi lugs su byas’’zhes gsal bas/rgyal khab phyi nang gi lag shes bzo rtsal gyi chu tshad ha cang mthon por slebs yod pa bden dpang byas yod/da dung / steng gnyis bang so rdza dang gza' la btab/ legs drug bang so g.ya' mtshams su btab/ spang la 'ja' tshon rgyas ba 'dra bo skad/ sde brgyad bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab// mtsho la kha ba babs pa 'dra'o skad//btsan lnga'i man chad bang so 'phying yul btab/ btsan lnga'i mchad pa sa phung sbrang 'drar yod//’’ces rdza dang g.ya'/ g.ya' mtshams/ spang / chu/ 'phying yul sogs go rim bsgrigs pa las kyang bod spyi tshogs 'gyur ldog gam/'phel rgyas byung yod pa tsam mtshon thub pa yin/53

sa bcad bzhi ba/ tshong las dpal 'byor/bod spyi tshogs kyi zhing 'brog las rigs mgyogs myur ngang 'phe~X rgyas byung ba'i mod la/ gnam gyi khri bdun dang stod kyi steng gnyis kyi skabs su/gser dngul zangs lcags kyi gter kha sngog 'don byed pa'i lag rtsal rgya cher dar ba dang bstun nas tshong las dpal 'byor la'ang gnam sa bla 'og brjes ba lta bu'i yar thon byung yod pa smos med yin te/ tshong las dpal 'byor ni spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho 'thus tshang gtong ba dang gong 'phel yong ba'i rang grub bgrod lam nyag gcig yin pas so/ 〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉 du 'di nas khri ngor snang btsan mong gi bus//bre phul srang bcos 'bru mar tshad kyis bcal//dga' gnyis tshong byas mthun gnyis la lung bsdebs’’ zhes dngos bo'i tshad de phra zhib ldan pa'i 'jal gshor 'degs gsum byed pa'i bre phul srang bcas dar khyab btang yod pas/ stod smad bar gsum gyi yul sde so so'i thon rdzas rnams nyo tshong brje res byed pa'i tshong las 'gro rgyug gi mtho rlabs zhig bslangs nas rim pa so so'i mi dmangs kyi dgos mkho cha tshang gtong gi yod/tshong zog gi rin gong gcig gyur byung nas tshong las de dmigs yul dang 'char gzhi/ khrims bkod gsum ldan can du bzos te bod spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi cha shas gal chen zhig tu gyur yod/ gnam ri srong btsan gyi ring la slebs dus bod nang khul du ma zad/ rgyal khab gzhan dang tshong 'brel byed pa'i lam lugs kyang byung yod de〈 rgya bod yig tshang 〉 du‘‘gru gu'i g.yu rnying /drel rgyab bco brgyad/ bod du slebs pa'ang de dus yin zer bar 'dugami’ces 54

gsungs so/srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la rgya phye tshang dang gru gu g.yu tshong / 'a zha gri tshong / ldan ma dar tshong / glan tshwa tshong ste zhes tshong las sna gcig gnyer mkhan byung yod pas/ tshong las 'phel rgyas dang 'thus tshang du gyur ba su yis bsnyon/ 〈 lde'u chos 'byung 〉las ‘‘stod na khrom kha chen mo gsum ste/ dru zha'i rgyal khams dang / dru gu dang / bal bo'o/ smad kyi khrom kha gsum la/ gar log rong rong / ldan ma'o/ dbus kyi khrom kha gnyis ni stong stong nyis so’’zhes dang / ‘‘khe brgyad ni las sgo chen mo la mnga' mdzad pa ste/ 'bro rje khri gsum rje rtags snang gis/ shar dar zab kyi las sgo phye ste mnga' mdzad/ 'bro chung gza' 'or mas/ nub rams dang rgya skyegs kyi las sgo phye ste mnga' mdzad/khyung po spu stangs kyis byang tshwa dang mdzo'i las sgo phye ste mnga' mdzad/ las sgo bzhi la che chung bzhi dang brgyad la/ bod khe la zhugs pas khe brgyad ces bya'o’’zhes pa sogs las/ khrom khe chen mo ni tshong rdzas brje res byed sa'i grong ngam khrom rwa chen por zer ba dang / khe brgyad ni gong gsal gyi mi sna de dag gtsos shar rgya nag dang dar gos sogs nyo tshong byed pa'i las sgo phyes bar mnga' dbang mdzad ces dang / lho rgya gar dang 'bras dang khre la sogs nyo tshong byed pa'i las sgo phyes nas mnga' dbang mdzad ces dang / nub stag gzig dang bal bo'i bar du tshos mdog sna tshogs nyo tshong byed pa'i las sgo phyes te mnga' mdzad ces dang / byang li yul dang sog po'i bar tshwa dang mdzo sogs kyi phyugs zog nyo tshong byed pa'i las sgo phyes te mnga' mdzad pa sogs bzhi yi re rer che chung gnyis re byas pa'i khe rigs brgyad sogs byung 'dug pas/mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab dang thon rdzas rnams 'char gzhi ldan pa'i ngang brje 55

spor byed pa'i lam lugs chags yod pa rtogs thub/ mu ne btsan po'i skabs su/ rang gi mnga' 'og gi 'bangs rnams la dbul phyug gi khyad par che bar ma mos bar bod 'bangs spyi'i dbul phyug thengs gsum snyoms te/ 'dzam gling steng du sngar byung ma myong pa'i spyi tshogs dpal 'byor bcos bsgyur byas nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lta ba thog mar gsar gtod dang lag len mdzad/da dung khong gi skabs ni bod kyi lo rgyus steng du ches 'byor phyug ldan pa'i dus rabs yin par bshad mkhan yang mang ngo //spyir btsan po'i rgyal rabs la mtshon na/ gnya' khri btsan po nas srong btsan sgam po'i bar du bod kyi rgyal 'bangs kun gyis srid 'byor rig gsum dar spel byed pa'i tsha rlabs zhig bslangs shing / bod 'di 'dzam gling zil gyis gnon la mtha' bzhi dbang du bsgyur ba'i rgyal khab stobs 'byor ldan pa zhig chags yod/ srong btsan gyi skabs su sangs rgyas chos lugs bsgyur 'dren byas pa nas bzung rgyal blon nang khul dang spyi 'bangs bar du ban bon rtsod pa'i 'gal ba byung bas bod kyi srid 'byor dmag gsum gong 'phel ma byung bar sngar dmas su lus ba dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su sad mi bdun byung ba nas bzung rgyal bo gtso byas pa'i blon 'bangs nang chos ba dag gis sangs rgyas chos lugs sgrub sbyong gi las la 'bad nas srid 'byor dmag gsum thad sngar bzhin mthong chen ma gnang ba dang / blon 'khor bon chos ba dag gis rgyal bo'i bka' bkod dang lam lugs dang len de tsam ma byas pa ma zad/ bod spyi tshogs gtor bshigs gtong ba'i las ngan yang dang yang du brtsams pa sogs ban bon bar gyi 'gal ba dza drag tu gyur ba'i khar/ khri ral gyi 'bangs khyim bdun res dge 'dun rer gsol ston sbyor dgos pa'i 56

lam lugs gtod pa dang / dge 'dun pa'i grangs tshad med 'phel ba dang bstun nas bod spyi tshogs kyi ngal rtsol nus shugs nyung ngur chags pa dang gcig spyi 'bangs kyi dpal 'byor khur bo je ljid du gyur ba dang gnyis/srid 'byor lam lugs la bkod 'dom zhib tshags thon med pa dang gsum/yul so so nas lha khang dang lha sku grangs med bzhengs pas rgyal 'bangs kun gyi mchod 'bul 'gro song mang du song ba dang bzhi yis rkyen byas te/ bod kyi srid 'byor dmag gsum nyams rgud du 'gro ba'i 'go brtsams yod par 'dod/

le'u bzhi pa/ bod sil bur 'thor rjes kyi dpal 'byor/spyir dus tshigs 'di'i nang du bod yongs la khyab pa'i dpal 'byor lam lugs zhig med pa dang gcig sil bur 'thor ba'i rjes kyi yul gru so so'i dpal 'byor gnas tshul gsal ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha dkon pa dang gnyis/kho bo yang slob mthar phyi la nye ba'i dus kyi ded pas zhib dpyad byed ma thub pa dang gsum gyis rkyen byas te le'u ma stong ba tsam byas pa'o/sa bcad dang po/ bod sil ba'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/de yang pur rgyal 'u dum btsan pos srid 'gan yongs su bzhes dus bod kyi srid 'byor dmag gsum ha cang nyams nga ba'i gnas su lhung yod pa ma bzod par/ grwa btsun rnams kyis rang kha rang gso byed ba dang / dge 'dun pa'i grangs tshad nyung du btang nas sangs rgyas chos lugs mu mthud du dar spel gtong bar tshod 'dzin byed dgos pa sogs srid lam bcos sgyur byas pa'i bka' lung bsgrags pa ma zad/ lha khang la la'i sgo rgyag pa dang / chos lugs dpe gzhung mang bo btsan sdud byas pa sogs kyi mdzad spyod la ma rangs bar bkrongs nas bod btsan po'i rgyal khab thor zhig tu gyur ba dang chabs cig bod spyi la khyab pa'i dpal 'byor lam lugs kyang khrims med lugs med du gyur ba dang / thog mar chen ma dang chun ma gtso byas pa'i dbang sgyur 58

gral rim nang khul du srid dbang 'phrog rtsod byas te ma mthun par ‘‘che srid chung srid dam mang tshan nyung tshan/ gser ba g.yu ba/ sha zan rtsam zan’’zhes so sor gyes shing / yun gyis rus tsho dang rus tsho/ sde tshan dang sde tshan/ lung ba dang lung ba/ phyoṭa dang phyoṭa/ dbus ba dang gtsang ba/ yul khams dang yul khams sogs su gyes 'thor byung nas rku 'phrog bcom gsum gyi las la rol te 'thab rtsod dmag 'khrug rgyun mi chad par byung ba ma zad/ ‘‘sa cha re la dpe re dang / lung ba re la chu re’’zhes pa'i dpe ltar sde dpon tsho dpon yul dpon lung gtso tshos rang bsam ci 'dod kyis khral rigs sna tshogs sdud pa je ljid nas je btsan du gyur bas/ gsas sne btsan gyis khul gtso byas pa'i yul phyogs so so nas 'bangs gyen langs byas/ 〈 bod kyi lo rgyus spyi don padma rā ga'i lde mig 〉tu ‘‘gong gi rgyal srid la mi mthun pa'i 'khrug rtsod dang /'og gi 'bangs la mu ge dang nad yams sogs mi 'dod pa sna tshogs kyis gang bas/ bod khams spyi la sdug bsngal mun pa ltar 'khrigs yod ’’ces dang /〈 lde'u chos 'byung 〉las/ ‘‘rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing 'dra ba ni chagachos khrims dar gyi mdud pa 'dra ba ni grol/ 'bangs khrims sog ma'i phon thag 'dra ba ni chad/ gnas dgon thams cad kyi za tshugs che tshugs nyams/rang lugs kyi gnas brtan dang chos kyi gzhi 'dzin pa rnams lho bal du bros/lha ris kyi dge bshes rnams kyis rgyal khrims chos khrims zhig pa la mya ngan byas kyang ma phan par sngar grongs so’’zhes gsal ba ltar du gyur/ lhag par du mnga' ris dang khams/ a mdo sogs tshab che bar 'dod/ de las yum brtan dang 'od srung gnyis kyi phyogs khag che shos yod cing / bod spyi ma zad kho tsho rang rang gi khongs la phan pa'i dpal 'byor lam lugs gtod thub med 59

par 'dod/ de ltar yun ring lon nas phyogs khag so so'i sger dbang brtan 'jags chags rjes/ bla chen dang mkhas pa mi gsum gtsos bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go brtsams nas slar yang yul lung so so nas chos lugs dar spel gtong ba'i mtho rlabs slong ba'i dus dang 'khel rkyen/ mang tshogs kyi zas gos la bshu gzhog byas te bsags pa'i dngul nor cung re yod pa 'khor 'bangs 'du byed kyi dmigs pas lha khang re gnyis bzheng bar btang yod tshod red/yul khams so so nas chos lugs rgya cher dar ba dang bstun nas grub mtha' mang po rim bzhin stobs ldan du gyur nas mthar bod kyi srid dbang yang chos bas bzung bar sems/chos srid rtsod pa'i phrag dog rab sdang bas//chos rgyal bdud du dmod nas bod khams dkrugs//srid 'byor dmag gsum nang 'khrigs chu bor bskur//mug sdug mun par rang nyid rang gis bcug /sa bcad gnyis pa/ sa skya ba'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/ de ltar bod kyi yul so so nas sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba'i rba rlabs lang long g.yos pa dang bstun nas rim bzhin sa skya ba/ 'bri gung / phag mo gru ba/ tshal ba/ stag lung pa/ g.ya' bzang bcas kyi stobs shugs dang khyab rgya che ru chags pas/ kho tshos kyang rang rang gi go gnas sra brtan dang khyab rgya che ru gtong ched/ stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i rgyab rten re mi 'tshol ka med du gyur pa lta bu zhig chags pas/ mong gol gyi rgyal sras che 'bring dag la 60

mchod yon gyi 'brel ba btsugs/ de las sa chen gyis hor rgyal por mchod yon gyi 'brel ba dam zab btsugs nas bod khri skor bcu gsum gyis hor rgyal la khral 'u 'jal mi dgos ba sogs byung bas/ bod 'bangs kyi dpal 'byor khur bo je yang du btang ba ma zad/ srid 'byor chos gsum gyi myu gu slar yang smin 'go tshugs/ lhag par du hu'u pe le yis bod phyogs kha (chol kha)gsum 'gro mgon 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gyi dbang yon du phul rjes/ 'phags pas bod yul du chos srid zung 'brel gyi srid dbang lam lugs thog mar btsugs shing / bod nang du khral 'u lag cha snyoms dang mi 'bor zhib bsher/ spyi tshogs sgrig 'god sogs mdzad nas bod kyi srid 'byor thams cad la 'phel rgyas chen po byung / phyi ru rgya sog gnyis gtso byas pa'i mtha' 'brel rgyal khab dang mi rigs khag bar srid 'byor chos gsum gyi 'brel ba btsugs te bod yul dar spel gtong thabs su 'bad kyi yod pa las dpal 'byor lam sna gsar ba 'dra gtod thub med par 'dod/gzhan yang dus skabs 'dir yul lung so so'i bla dpon tsho'i spyi tshogs go gnas ha cang mthon po yod pa mi la ras ba'i rnam thar du‘‘stod mnga' ris skor gsum nas gser dang g.yu brgya 'bul stong 'bul// smad mdo khams sgang drug nas ji sigs dang gos dar brgya 'bul stong 'bul// bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi nas snam phrug dang mar nas brgya 'bul stong 'bul// byang dwags kong gsum nas mdzo rta dang gnag lug brgya 'bul stong 'bul//’’zhes gsung ba lta bu zhig tu gyur yod/ khong tshos rang yul so so nas bstan pa dar spel dang dgon sde gsar 'dzugs byas shing / rtag brtan phun tshogs gling dang dzam thang dgon pa/ dzam thang gtsang ba dgon/ jo nang dgon 61

sogs gtso byas pa'i dgo sde mang po btab yod cing / sngar las lhag pa'i bzo bkod lag rtsal khyad par ba byung med par 'dod/ sa skya'i dbang sgyur gyi smad tsam du slebs dus/ yul phyogs so so'i dge 'dun pa'i grangs tshad nyin bzhin 'phar ba dang / yul dpon phal cher yang sger gnyer lam lugs su shor ba dang bstun te mang tshogs kyi khral 'u je ljid du song nas bod mang tshogs kyi nam mkhar slar yang dka' sdug gi mun pa 'khrigs pas/ 'bri gung gling log byung nas sa skya ba'i srid dbang 'thor zhig song te phag gru bas srid skyong byung ba red/sa bcad gsum pa/ phag mo gru ba'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/de yang phag gru bka' rgyud kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed phag mo gru ba rdo rje rgyal pos (1110 — 1170)phag gru'i gdan sa thel btab ste/ mnyam med dwags po'i gdams ngag gtso bor gyur ba'i mdo sngags gzhung lugs thun mong ma yin pa spel ba la phag gru bka' rgyud ces bya ba'i mtshan thogs pa yin/spyan snga ba grags pa 'byung gnas (1175— 1255)gyis 'bri gung skyob pa bla mar bsten zhing / bla mas bsngags brjod dang bcas phag gru ba'i gdan sa bzung mod/ skabs 'dir da dung phag gru bar zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi mchod 'bul yong 'bab tsam las med/ de'i gcung rgyal ba thogs rdugs ba'i skabs su hor rgyal hu la hur gtogs pa'i bod khul sa khang mi gsum gyi dbang ris rnams gong ma'i lung gis phag gru bas bdag thob byas chog pa byung ba bzhin thog mar ldan ma sgom brtson gyis 'bri gung dang phag gru'i spyi dpon 62

byas shing / de rjes dpon rdo rje dpal hor gong ma'i lung gis phag gru'i khri dpon du bskos skabs/ pho brang sgang tshong 'dus brag kha sogs gzhis ka gnyis brtsigs pas/ bod du gzhis ka'i lam lugs thog mar byung / phag gru'i mnga' 'bangs kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor la 'phel rgyas kyi drod rlabs glo bur 'phyur/ de rjes kyi khri dpon gzhon rgyal mtshan dang / khri dpon rin rgyal ba/ khri dpon byang gzhon pa gsum bag med spyod pa'i dbang du song ste phag gru'i mnga' khongs 'phel ba la phan pa'i dpal 'byor bya thabs ci yang ma byung /de rjes kyi khri dpon gzhon nu yon tan nag chang kho na'i dbang du shor bas phag grur nyams rgud chen po byung / de nas phag gru khri dpon bdun pa phag gru'i khri dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod yongs mnga' 'og tu bsdus shing /bod yongs la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i phag grwa sde srid kyi ming yang thog mar byung ba ma zad/ phag gru sde srid kyi srid dbang dngos su tshugs/ de nas phag gru'i sde srid bcu pa zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa'i bar du byung ba'i dpal 'byor gnas tshul la/gcig spyi tshogs dpal 'byor lam lugs legs bcos byas tshul/skabs 'dir 〈 zhal lce bco lnga 〉 sogs kyi spyi tshogs sgrig khrims gsar 'dzugs dang mi don sgrig bkod sogs byas te bod spyi tshogs zhi 'jags dang kha phyogs yod pa'i lam du bkod pa ma zad/ 〈 tā'i si tu'i gsol 'debs ring mo〉nang /‘‘lha sde mi sde'i tshur nyon dang // 63
