sngar 'u lag grangs med la/ da lta dud re 'u lag re //dmag kyang de 'dra ba la//’’zhes gsal bas mang tshogs kyi dpya khral 'jal tshad je yang du btang pa sogs kyi bod spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor dar rgyas gtong ba'i rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi bting zhing / 〈 tā'i si tu'i gsol 'debs ring mo'i〉nang du‘‘thal ba lag mthil tsam zhig med//zhing gi mu la bye'u mi thar//ri klung med pa zhing du song //de phyi'i skad ngan 'don don med’’ces gsal ba ltar zhing las thon skyed gong 'phel legs po byung ba dang / yang de ru ‘‘bu rta mi sde mi dmangs la//dmag jus legs pa'i 'bras bu yis// gser dngul zangs lcags spyad pa dang // dar gos gser g.yu rin chen dang // bar thul thong ring g.yon bsnol dang // phag rigs slog pa khyad 'phags dang // mdzo rta khyu dras byed pa dang // gnag lug khyu dus byed pa dang // nor rdzas lam la shong tshad drangs///bdag la gnang phud zho gang ma// dar kha gang yang 'bul mi red//’’zhes gsungs pa ltar mtha' bzhir dmag 'thab byas pa las thob pa'i rgyu nor rnams kyang srid gzhung du bsdu rub ma byas pas mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba 'dzoms byupo byung yod par 'dod//gnyis pa/ lag shes batho las dar tshul/de yang 〈 skye dgu mdzes par byed pa'i mgul rgyan 〉 du‘‘bka' bstan bzhengs ba'i mthun rkyen lo re bzhin//gser zho sum brgya bdun cu don gsum dang // 64

shog rin ṭam kha brgya dang sum cu re//nas khal brgyad brgya bzhi bcu zhe gsum nyid//ston chas sha khog bzhi brgya nyi shu gnyis//mar khal sum brgya lnga bcu nga bdun dang //bur khal bdun cu don gsum khor yug nyid//zho grangs brgyad brgya nyi shu rtsa gsum lon//’’zhes gsal ba ltar skabs der dpon 'bangs kun gyis rang mos ngang dgon pa gsar 'debs dang / rten gsum gsar bzhengs byas nas bod rigs bzo las lag rtsal dar rgyas chen po byung yod/ da lta lo rgyus kyi 'od stong rnam par 'phro zhing snyan grags kyi ba dan lhab lhub g.yo bzhin pa'i‘‘chos sde chen po rtsed thang dang / 'bras spungs/dge ldan/ se ra/ ngor e waṃ chos sde/ rgyal rtse dpal mgon mchod rten//'phags yul na len dra// sde dge thang rgyal lha khang / chab mdo chos 'khor gling / bkra shis lhun po/ rta nag thub bstan gling / gdan sa chen po yangs can dgon/ dre hor/ dar rgyas dgon pa/ sku 'bum byams pa gling / mdo khams li thang dgon chen// jo nang rtag brtan gling / rdo brag e waṃ lcog sgar’’sogs gsar 'dzugs byas pa ma zad/ ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang /bsam yas dgon sogs la nyams gso rgya cher byas te bod kyi lha bzo'i lag rtsal sogs rig gnas dpal 'byor gong 'phel snga na med pa zhig byung yod cing / dgon pa'i grangs 'bor mang du 'phel ba dang bstun nas grwa ba'i grangs 'bor ldab 'gyur mang pos gong 'phel byung bas/ bod mang tshogs kyi dngos po'i dpal byor la nyams rgud mngon gsal ldan pa byung /gzhan yang〈 g.yu yi phreng ba 〉las‘‘phag gru sde srid kyis yul lung dar 65

rgyas yong ba'i ched du sdong 'dzugs nags bzo'i bya ba de gcigs cher bzung bas/ skabs der bod yongs kyi sa khul tshang mar ljon myug 'dzugs pa'i bya ba gong 'phel byung stabs yul lung nyams dga' ba'i rnam pa sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur ldog byung bar ma zad/’’zhes gsal ba ltar sdong phran gsar 'dzugs byas nas khor yug legs bcos byas pa dang / 〈 deb ther kun gsal me long 〉las‘‘skabs don thang stong rgyal pos bod kyi sa gnas khag la lcags zam lnga bcu nga brgyad dang / gru shan brgya dang bco brgyad/ shing zam drug cu tsam btsugs shing bzos’’ces gsal ba las la la 'jig tshar yang / gcung ri bo che'i lcags zam dang / lha rtse'i lcags kha lcags zam gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i la lar da lta'ang bod mi rnams 'grul bzhud byed kyin yod pa ma zad/ bod kyi chos ldan pa'i gru shan rta mgo can bcings 'grol btang ba'i rjes su yang lha sa'i skyid chu'i thog tu mthong rgyu yod ces smra/ yang‘‘kong po'i yul du lcags zam rdung ba'i bzo grwa bskrun par gnang’’zhes dang‘‘mi rnams kyis phul ba'i lcags mgar ba mang pos rdung bas/ zhag bco brgyad la lcags kyi rkang bu 'dom bco brgyad yod pa bzhi grub’’zhes sogs gsal bas/ skabs der bod kyi bzo las lag rtsal tshad mthon po med dam snyam gyi yod/ da dung phag gru'i skabs su bka' 'gyur gyi par shing thog mar byung ba sogs par brkos lag rtsal dpal 'byor yang 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod/ 66

sa bcad bzhi ba/ gtsang ba rgyal bo'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/gtsang pa rgyal bo phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis bod yongs la dbang bsgyur dngos su byas pa bsgrags pa'i sngon gyi rin spungs ba'i dus su dbus gtsang gtsos bod yongs la grub mtha'i nang 'khrug gi me lce rab tu 'bar ba dang /spyi tshogs grub stangs rnyog 'dzing che ba/ gzhug tu'ang bod spyi la phan pa'i 〈zhal lce bcu drug 〉 tsam las spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dar rgud thad byed thabs mngon gsal can spyod thub med pa yin nam snyam pa las zhib mor dpyad khom ma byung ngo //sa bcad lnga ba/ dge ldan pa'i skabs kyi dpal 'byor/de yang rgyal dbang lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtshos sog po dang 'brel nas gtsang ba rgyal po'i 'khor dang rjes 'brangs thams cad rim gyis tshar bcad rjes〈 rgyal khrims zhal lce bcu gsum 〉 gtan 'bebs khyab bsgrags mdzad de bod yongs la chos srid 'khor lo dbang gis bskor ba nas bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol ma thob pa'i bar gyi dge ldan ring lugs pa'i dus su bod kyi zhing phyug las rigs gtsos lag shes bzo las dang / thon skyed sgrig gzhi/tshong las do dam sogs gang thad la bcos bsgyur bkod sgrig thengs mang byas pa dang / lhag par du rgyal ba bdun pa'i bka' shag srid gzhung btsugs pa 67

dang / rgyal ba bcu gsum pas spyi lo 1913lor‘‘gzhung sger dgon sde sogs kyis bdag nyar byas pa'i sa stong rnams mi sus rmo rko byed cing sa zhing du bsgyur na rang mos su bed spyod byed chog par ma zad/ lo gsum gyi ring la khral 'jal mi dgos’’pa'i bka' bsgrags pa sogs zhing las lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i shugs snon mdzad pa dang / spyi lo 1923lor ja sdong 'debs 'dzugs byed pa'i tshod lta'i las khungs btsugs te las 'go dngos su brtsams pa/ lha sa'i grong du nyen srung dmag sgar gsar 'dzugs gnang ste spyi tshogs bde 'jags la shugs snon mdzad pa dang / spyi lo 1925lor sbrag khang dang tar khang sogs gsar 'dzugs gnang ste 'grim 'grul dang cha 'phrin las ka la shugs snon gnang ba/ dngul khang gsar du btsugs pa sogs spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la phan pa che ba'i byed thabs sna tshogs spyad yod cing /bod 'brug dang / bod rgya/ bod sog bod dang gor kha grub mtha' dang grub mtha'/ dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul sogs kyi bar du 'gal ba dang /'khrug rtsod gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung ba dang dge 'dun pa'i grangs tshad gong nas gong du 'phel bar bstun nas ngal rtsol nus shugs nyung du song ba dang ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi 'gan khur ljid du chags pa sogs kyis rkyen byas te bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel tshad sngar gnas su lus ba'am 'phel rgyas chen po phyin med par 'dod/sa bcad drug pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis bod dpal 'byor la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen/ya thog gi mi rnams kyis rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod byed skabs su/ 68

bsam yul las 'das pa'i snang tshul sna tshogs kyis chos lugs sam lha 'dre'i lta ba thog mar skyed cing 'phel rgyas byung pa yin/ bod la mtshon na/ spyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs bdun pa tsam nas chos lugs (bon )de spyi tshogs kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig tu gyur zhing / gzhung dang nyams len gang thad nas cung tsam cha tshang ba'i tshad du slebs yod tshod red/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su mdo rgyud nyer gcig sogs bsgyur nas sangs rgyas chos lugs de bod srid gzhung gis spel 'go brtsams pa yin la/phyi gling rig gnas kyis bod du btsan 'dzul byas pa'i thog ma yin/ de dang sngar gyi bod spyi tshogs las brdol ba'i rang re'i sa skyes rdo skyes kyi rig gnas sam chos lugs pa bon po dang thog mar 'gal 'du'i bsam blo 'bus shing rim bzhin rno ngar can du chags/ chos rgyal khri srong sde btsan gyis mkhan slob gnyis sogs spyan drangs nas bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing /nang chos sngar las lhag pa'i bsgyur spel byas pa ma zad/ sad mi bdun gyis mtshon pa'i dge 'dun pa'i sde thog mar byung / sangs chos de chos lugs khe phan gtso sgrub bya ba'i mtho rlabs thog dang por bslangs/ de nas btsan ngo/ khri ral ba can gyis dgon pa 'ga' zhig la sa zhing dang 'brog thang phyugs rigs bcas mchod rgyun du sprad pa bcas sangs rgyas chos lugs dar rgyas chen po btang / skabs de'i dgon pa dang lha khang / grwa ba bcas kyi grangs 'bor dang dpal 'byor thon khungs thad〈 dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉 du‘‘de'i ring gi dgon par mtshon na/ nang chos slob grwa 12 dang / lha khang gsar rnying 18 sgom grwa che chung 16 bcas bsdoms na 46 dang / de thog srong btsan rang gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang 15 / 69

khri lde gtsug brtan gyis bzhengs pa 5 btsun mo rim byung gis bzhengs pa 8mchod gnas slob dpon rim byung gis bzhengs ba 35bcas bsdoms pa'i gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa grangs 133yod pa dang / glang dar ma yan chod kyi bsam yas dang mchims phu/ yer ba/ chu bo ri bcas dgon khag bzhi la grwa ba bsdoms na 305yod cing / de 'phros rnams la cha snyoms grwa ba 100yod par cha bzhag na/ grwa ba 1032yod pa'i khar gong gsal dgon khag bzhi'i grwa grangs bsnan na grwa ba 1337yod cing / de las mang po med/ dus skabs de'i ring grwa ba dang / slob dpon/ slob ma bcas la lo rer rgyal po'i mdzod nas phogs thob sprod pa ma gtogs mchod gzhis sa zhing dang / phyugs rigs/ rtswa thang sogs gang yang med cing / phogs thob kyang rim pa mi 'dra bar gzhigs pa'i thob bya mang nyung gi tshad gzhi gtan 'bebs yod tshul 〈 sba bzhed〉nang gsal ba ltar gong gsal grwa grangs rnams la lo rer cha snyoms kyi phogs thob nas khal 25dang / mar khal 11 dang srang 30re sprod pa'i dbang du byas na 'bri khal 33425dang (deng sang gi rgya mar phab na 935900)mar khal /1 dang srang 30(rgya ma 80)grwa ba'i grangs kyis bsgyur ba'i thob grangs rgya ma 106960yin zhes gsal zhing / bod dpal 'byor dar spel gtong ba'i bsam blo gsar ba'i gnya' gnon lta bu'am srid gzhung dpal 'byor yong 'bab kyi khur bo gtso bo zhig tu gyur rkyen/ bod dpal 'byor dang chab srid dmag don dag nyams rgud du 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bor gyur ba ma zad/ mtha' mar bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud gcod byed kyi ral gri lta bu'am bod sil bur 'thor byed kyi sman rdzas lta bur song ba ni bden grub tshad ma yin pas nga tshos khas len mi byed thabs med yin la/ u tshugs mtha' 70

'khyongs byed par dgos ba'ang med/ lhag par du bod sil bu'i skabs su/bka' gdams bka' rgyud sa skya sogs grub mtha' mang po dar zhing / chos lugs de grub mtha' so sos srid dbang sgyur byed kyi bsam blo kho nar gyur 'dug la/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas bas nang chos de bod kyi rtsa khrims lta bur gyur ba mtshon zhing / sangs rgyas chos lugs rgya cher dar nas dge 'dun pa dang dgon sde/chos dad pa bcas kyi grangs 'bor nyin bzhin dar ba dang bstun te/ bod mi dmangs kyis rang yul dar spel gtong ba'i blo sems je zhum dang / las gnyer mi dmangs kyi 'gan babs je ljid/ bod kyi mi grangs je nyung / chos pa ma zad 'jig rten pa dag la'ang 'jig rten gyi bde ba dang longs spyod 'tshol 'dun drag po med par tshe phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i srol chags pas/bod kyi dpal 'byor de ha cang yid skyo zhing nyam thag pa'i tshul gyis slar yang rang byung dpal 'byor tsam la rten dgos pa byung 'dug da dung 〈 deng rabs bod ljongs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/〉zhes pa'i nang du (249)‘‘nga tshos grwa ba dang dgon pa'i kha grangs la bltas na/ rgyal dbang lnga bas srid gnyer dus rabs kyi stod du dge lugs par gtogs pa'i dgon pa 334dang / grwa ba 151941 tsam las med cing / lo 40rjes kyi 1733lor dgon pa 3477dang / grwa ba 471930tsam du 'phar 'dug khams kyi nub phyogs dang thad gtogs min pa'i dgon pa brtsis tshe/ grwa ba'i grangs 'bor khri phrag brgal 'dug rjes nas kyang 'phar snon chen po byung yod/dmangs gco'i bcos bsgyur gyi sngon du/ bod la grwa ba dang jo mo khri phrag 11lhag tsam yod la/ skabs de'i bod spyi'i mi grangs kyi 10phro lhag zin 'dug71

dkar mjes bod rigs rang skyong khul du/ 1956lo'i sngon la dgon pa 195dang / bla ma dang grwa ba/ jo mo bcas bsdoms pas 64000lhag yod/spyi'i mi grangs kyi 13lko dang / li thang gi spyi'i mi grangs kyi 31phrozin 'duga.a mdo mtsho sngon du tshad ldan dgon pa 650dang / grwa ba 57649dang /sprul sku 1240dang / kan su'u ru bod rigs dgon pa 369dang / grwa ba dang jo mo khri 1 69dang / bla sprul 310 dang / si khron rnga pa khul smar khams rdzong du bod rigs dgon pa 87dang / grwa btsun 3000lhags yod pa ma zad/khul yongs la grwa btsun khri 3lhag 'dugayun nan bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul du dgon pa 20lhag yod par dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur sngon la grwa btsun 2000lhag dang / grwa btsun lag khyer sprad zin pa 1 226yod cing / grwa btsun gyis sa gnas bod rigs grangs 'bor gyi rdozin gyi yod/’’ zhes dang / 〈 dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung rtsom phyogs sgrigs〉du'ang ‘tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa sku 'das rjes chos lugs phyogs med kyi dgon pa 1807yod khongs su mchod gzhis mi ser yod pa'i dgon pa 37las med cing / mdo dbus khams gsum gyi grwa ba'i grangs 'bor 221742tsam yod(rnam thar du gsal)/ bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur btang ba'i lo sngon ma bar mchod gzhis yod pa'i dgon grangs ldab gcig 'phar yod par cha bzhag na dgon pa 74las zin med pa dang / bod ljongs yongs kyi grwa ba'i bsdoms 'bor ldab gcig 'phar yod par cha bzhag na grwa grangs 443484zin dgos pa red/’’ces ba/ba/shātpa ces/yang der ‘tshod rtsis byas na/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur sngon du bod 72

la grwa ba khri 30tsam 'dug bod spyi'i mi 'bor gyi 10phro brgal 'dug’’zhes bris 'dug kun gyis shes gsal ltar/ 'di dag phal cher gzugs stobs dar zhing blo rig rgod pa'i gzhon skyes pho sar tag tag yin/ 'di 'dra'i mi mang po zhig gis spyi tshogs dar spel gyi thon skyed ngal rtsol ma byas pa'i khar/kho rang tsho'i zas gos sdod shag kun mang tshogs kyis mchod 'bul byed dgos pa ma zad/ da dung 〈 mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉las zhogs dung gis bris pa'i 〈 bag chags sprug bton 〉ces pa'i khrod du ‘‘'jon thang mi gtso rgyud pa gtso ba'i dpe srol/ shes rgya mi gtso bgres po gtso ba'i dpe srol/gnas lugs mi gtso lung bstan gtso ba'i dpe srol/ dngos stobs mi gtso bshad rgyun gtso ba'i dpe srol/ tshil dreg che na bsod nams yin zer ba'i dpe srol/ shig 'bu mang na tshogs gsog yin zer ba'i dpe srol/ che bar 'phrad na lce bsnar rkub 'phur gyi dpe srol/ bya dngos kun la las kyis 'grel ba'i dpe srol/ 'gro 'dug thams cad rten 'brel brtag pa'i dpe srol/btsan dang chen por kha gsag smra ba'i dpe srol/ drang ldog kun la ya ya brjod pa'i dpe srol/ ya rabs ma rabs g.yung mos phye ba'i dpe srol/ byis pa'i gnyen don pha mas sgrig pa'i dpe srol/ sgrig dang khrims la ji mi snyam pa'i dpe srol/ sram dang g.yu byur 'dogs cha khur bor gyur ba'i dpe srol/gzhan yang / mgo bo yod kyang klad pa mi spyod pa'i rang gshis/ btsan la gnyom zhing gnyom la btsan pa'i rang gshis/ phrag dog che zhing ru nga skyen pa'i rang gshis/ chung ngu tsam gyis yid tshim sla ba'i rang gshis/ phag pa lta bu'i le lo che ba'i rang gshis/ ri dwags lta bu'i sos dal bag phebs rang gshis/'dod pa chung la chog shes che ba'i rang gshis/ spyi yi don rnams yal bar 73

'dod pa'i rang gshis/ rang gi don la 'char gzhi med pa'i rang gshis/byas pa'i las la sa chod med pa'i rang gshis/ nang mi gyod pa bag mi tsha ba'i rang gshis/ thun mong rgyu la hab sha rgyag pa'i rang gshis/ rdza se rdzu ser dad pa che ba'i rang gshis/ g.yo dang sgyu la dogs slong bral ba'i rang gshis’’zhes gsal ba lta bu 'jig rten pas bltas na chos yin la/ chos bas bltas na chos ma yin pa'i bsam spyod tha shal ba/ sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams pa'i gshed ma/ spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi zungs khrag 'jub pa'i bdud 'dre lta bur gyur zhing / sangs rgyas bstan par skyon shor ba'i bsam ngan skyug bro ba mang po dar bas bod dpal 'byor de lto gos dkon pa'i gnas bab 'di lta bu zhig tu lhung ba red 'dod kyi yod/ 'di ltar brjod pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs gtan nas mi dgos zer ba min/ bod rgyud sangs rgyas chos lugs rang rgyal ma zad/ 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi bang mdzod nang na gzi 'od rnam par 'phro bzhin pa'i rang mi rigs rig gnas kyi grub gzhi gtso bo yin pas de 'dra brjod kyang mi srid/ 'on kyang / sangs rgyas chos lugs 'di'ang 'char gzhi dang rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i sgo nas dar spel gtong dgos tshod ma red dam snyam pa yin/ dper na/ grwa bar tshod 'dzin byas te grwa ba'i rgyu spus je bzang du gtong ba dang / dgon khag so sos tshong khang dang za khang / par khang /mgron khang / yul skor sa tshugs bcas btsugs nas dpal 'byor dgos mkho rang las rang sprod thub pa bcas byung tshe/ deng sang bod spyi tshogs su ma yin yin khul gyis 'gro bzhin pa'i lha ba mo ba dang / grong chog pa/ lam dngul chad pa'i mjal skor ba dang dgon pa'am sku gdung ga ge mo 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i slong mo ba/ sprul sku mar rtsod pa sogs dmar thar thar chos kyi 74

don du min par dngul gyi don dang / mang tshogs la dge ba sgrub phyir min par mgo g.yog rdzun skor bya phyir 'khyams bzhin pa sogs ma zad/ dgon khag mang shas su 'phrin skur tsam yang 'bri mi nus pa'i grong dge mang ba sogs kyi gnas tshul bcos bsgyur byas na sangs rgyas bstan par rim bzhin dag ther dar spel gtong thub pa ma zad/ bod spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gyi khur 'gan yang je yang du gtong thub nges yin/ lhag par du nga tsho'i mig mdun du lhags pa'i dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni rig gnas 'gran rtsod drag pa'i dus rabs zhig yin rkyen/ dngos gnas grangs 'bor mi gtso rgyu spus gtso ba'i tshad du slebs yod/ de'i phyir/ de ltar bya ba ni sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel gtong bar bkag sdom dang sngon 'gog bzo ba zhig min par sngar las lhag par 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i rtsa ba'i cha rkyen yin pa ma zad/ ‘‘dri ldan pad ma rgyang ring yang // bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor ’’zhes ba ltar/sbyin bdag dang chos dad mang tshogs kyang sngar las lhag pa'i 'phel byed ma red dam bsam gyi yod/

le'u lnga pa/ bod dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi thar lam/da rang nyid kyi lag dmar rang nyid red 'dugangs ci ltar drag chas bzung nas dgra sha rtsod/rgyal khab bam mi rigs gang rung zhig gi rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor 'phel tshad ji 'dra yod na/ rgyal khab bam mi rigs de'i gnas bab kyang de 'dra zhig yin nges bas/ spyi tshogs gang zhig yin yang / thog mar dpal 'byor dar spel gtong bar brtson gnyer rgya cher byed rgyu spyi tshogs de'i mi dmangs kyis rang nyid srung skyob byas nas stobs 'byor ldan pa'i lam du bskyod pa'i sngon 'gro gcig rkyang yin srid/ kha la zas dang rgyab la gos/ lag la dngul tsam yang med par bya ba ci zhig byas kyang 'grub dka' zhing / sgrub pa'i sems shugs dang stobs rtsal yang yod dka' bar 'dod kyi yod/ de'i phyir/ ‘da lta ni dngul yod pa tsho'i rtsed rig yin (74shuṣṭhaṭwāṃ.āoṃrmirkikhyenya oṃtsho)’’zhes bshad par yang don snying med pa zhig ma red bsam gyi 'dugad lo tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rang rgyal nub khul sgo 'byed chen mo'i srid jus dngos su brtson len byed rgyu khyab bsgrags byas bas/ krung go'i nub khul gyi gshin sa ru re bzhag gi myu gu 'bus shing / zhi bde dang 'phel rgyas kyi 'od mdangs 'khu ba'i ljang mdog zhig gang sa gang du mngon 'go brtsams pas/ nub khul sgo 'byed chen mo'i srid jus ni —dngos gnas tshan rig lag rtsal gyi zhwa mo dbu la mnab cing grangs med khri phrag 76

gi rogs dngul rum du bcug spobs sems zhum med kyi gri ring sked du bcings/ 'bad brtson lhod med kyi lcags lham rkang mgor gyon/ nub khul dar spel gyi rgyal dar mtho ru bsgrengs/ rjes lus dbul skyob kyi 'bod tshig shed kyis sgrogs kyin dus rabs gsar rnying gnyis kyi brje mtshams nas slebs shing / lo rgyus kyi gzi 'od chem chem 'phro bzhin pa'i dus rabs gsar ba'i rgyal sras te —ge krung go nub khul ba'i mgon skyabs gcig pu yin pa kun gyis gsal bor rtogs shing / nub khul mi'i sems khongs su re bzhag gsar ba'i drod khol 'khyil zhing / mig nang nas snying stobs gsar ba'i 'od zer mched/ gdong ngos nas mdun lam gsar ba'i spro sems 'dzum/ ngag dbyangs su srid jus gsar ba'i dge mtshan bkug dbu khrid tshor jus gzhi gsar ba byung / spang ljongs su myu gu gsar ba 'bus/ bar snang du rlung bu gsar ba g.yug ri lung kun glu sgra gsar bas khyab pa sogs gsar ba khri phrag gi drag chas bzung nas dus rabs gsar ba dang mnyam por 'jig rten gsar ba zhig gam spyi tshogs gsar ba zhig skrun grabs byed par brel gyi 'dug pa dang kun nas mtshungs so/rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi drung yig chen mo wang krung yus(1sgyuhlasno)lags tshogs chen gnyis kyi skabs su bod kyi 'thus mir 'phrad skabs ‘‘bod kyis nub khul sgo 'byed chen mo'i go skabs dam 'dzin nan po byas nas/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong bar mthong chen bya dgos pa ma zad/ lhag par du dpal yon gnyis mnyam spel dang / gzhi rim srid dbang 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon/ chab srid bsam blo'i las don drag gnyer/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags srung skyob dang mi rigs mthun sgril gyi rang mgul rang gshis la shugs sgrim 77

byed dgos’’zhes bstan pa ltar/ nga tshos nub khul sgo byed chen po'i go skabs dam 'dzin byas te/ rang yul gyi rjes lus rnam pa bsgyur par 'bad brtson hur thag bya rgyu ni/ gcig na tang krung dbyang gi 'char 'god dmigs 'ben 'grub phyir yin la/ gnyis na rang 'gan rang gis khur nas rang yul rang gis spel ba ma red dam bsam gyi yod/'o na/ nga tshos nub khul sgo 'byed chen mo'i go skabs ji ltar dam 'dzin byed dgos zhe na/ 'di ni 'go khrid gcig gnyis zhig gam 'bangs mi bcu phrag zhig dang 'brel ba'i gnad don zhig ma yin par bod mi kun dang 'brel ba'i don chen zhig red bsam gyi 'dug de'i phyir/ kho bos ma skul dang blangs sgos/ nub khul sgo 'byed chen mo'i srid jus 'og bod kyi dpal 'byor ji ltar dar spel gtong stangs thad lhag bsam dkar pos bsam gzhig byas ba 'di lta ste/sa bcad dang po/ bod kyi deng rabs zhing las spel thabs/en ki si (moṣṭhachalo)lags kyis ‘‘zhing las ni gna' rabs 'dzam gling yongs su nges par du yod dgos pa'i thon skyed byed sgo zhig yin la/ da lta lhag par du 'di ltar yin ’’zhes gsungs ba ltar/ zhing las dar rgud kyis 'dzam gling mi dmangs yongs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad la thad kar tshod 'dzin byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ 'brog las dang bzo las sogs byed sgo gzhan gyi thon skyed dar rgud la'ang shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod/ bod la mtshon na/ zhing las ni gna' deng gnyis kar rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi srog shing lta bu'am 78

rmang gzhi gtso bo yin/ de'i phyir/ zhing las rgud pa'i 'byung rkyen dang 'phel ba'i thabs lam btsal nas zhing las thon skyed dar spel gtong rgyu bod dmangs kyi lto 'bras gcig rkyang dang 'brel ba'i gnad don zhig ma yin par/bod mi rigs kyi dar rgud dang dam por 'brel ba zhig yin rkyen/ mdo dbus khams gsum gyi lung grog sgang gzhung re re na gnas pa'i bod mi kun gyis bsam gzhig rnal ma bya dgos pa zhig yin/cigacig zhing las thon skyed kyi shes rtogs mthor 'degs gtong dgos/spyir bya ba ci zhig byed cing / thog mar bya ba de byed pa'i shes rtogs gsal bo zhig yod dgos/ shes rtogs de las mched pa'i bsam blo g.yo ba med la/ zhum pa med pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ thabs jus dang re bas khengs pa'i bsam blo zhig kyang yin srid 'dod/ der brten/ zhing las kyi dgos mkho dang / dge mtshan shes rtogs mthar phyin byas na/ bod kyi rang byung thon khungs 'dzoms po yod pas/ zhing las dpal 'byor rgya cher spel thabs med pa zhig gtan nas min/ gtso bo rang cag gi klad pa'i rtsal dang / lus kyi brtson pa/ sems kyi spobs pas ma yong ba red 'dod kyi yod/ bod mi'i‘‘khyed kyi las min/ khor phan pa med/ ngas mi nus’’ces dpa' zhum bzur bshol byed pa'i mgo 'dogs rang gshis skyug bro ba 'di ha cang drag po red/zhing las ni mi'i rigs kyi zas 'bru'i 'byung khungs yin la/ 'tsho ba'i srog shing yang yin pas/ ma mtha' yang rang mi rigs kyi zas 'bru rang las rang sprod thub pa zhig dgos pa las/ nam rgyun zas 'bru tsam yang gzhan nas 79

'dren dgos tshe/ bod mi'i rjes lus rnam pa nam yang bsgyur mi thub pa ma zad/bod kyi yul lung thams cad bye thang dang / bye ri/ bye sa/ grog rong / sa rgod bcas su 'gyur nas mi dmangs yod rgu 'khyams shing ldom ste bod mi rigs ces ba'ang lo rgyus steng gi ming tshig gcig tu 'gyur nyen de'ang zhing las dar spel btang nas 'tsho ba 'phel rgyas dang khor yug legs bcos byed par 'brel ba che ba zhig kyang yin no/gnyis/ zhing sa srung skyob dang legs bcos byed dgos/zhing sa srung skyob dang legs bcos byed rgyu zhing las thon skyed kyi rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen yin la/ zhing las thon rdzas spus legs dang zhing las dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i sngon 'gro'ang yin/(1)zhing sa srung skyob dang rgya bskyed gtong dgos/ bod yul gyi ri sgang mtho ba dang bde thang chung ba/ lhag par du mdo dbus khams gsum gyi ri thang gnyis ka bye sar 'gyur bzhin pa'i gnas tshul ha cang tshabs chen 'dug pas/ sngar yod zhing sar srung skyob dang / sa gshis gnas bab bzang ba'i sgang gzhung dag bcos bsgyur byas te 'char gzhi dang go rim yod pa'i sgo nas zhing sa rgya bskyed gtong rgyu ha cang gal chen red/(2) zhing sa'i rgyu gshis bzang ngan gyis thad kar zhing las thon rdzas kyi spus ka dang 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod la/ zhing las thon rdzas kyi rtsa ba'i thon skyed rgyu chas kyang 'don sprod byed kyi yod pas/ zhing ra'i rgyu gshisaci rgyu cha de dag ni zhing las thon rdzas skye 'phel yong ba'i sman rdzas lta bu'am zas bcud lta bu yin stabs/ dpyad zhib nan pos rgyu rdzas sna tshogs 80

gsab 'don byas nas zhing ra'i rgyu gshis 'dzoms po yong bar brtson dgos/(3)gnod 'bu byung par sngon 'gog bya dgos/ bod mir chos dad che bas/ gnod 'bu mang po babs na sdig par 'dzem nas 'gog gsod byed par dogs tshe/ zhing las thon skyed la gnod pa tshabs chen byed nges yin pas/gnod 'bu 'gog gsod byas te zhing rar srung skyob byed dgos/gsum/ tshan rtsal la brten nas zhing ra'i khor yug 'dzugs bskrun byed dgos/nang sa rgyu'i cha rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i khar/ phyi 'byung bzhi'i ('dir chu rlung nam mkha' bzhi ston)mthun rkyen cha tshang 'dzoms pa'i zhing ra'i khor yug zhig 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu zhing las thon skyed 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi yin/ dper na/ zas sbyor zhim po yong bar/ bro rdzas dang zas chu'i mang nyung / me'i drod tshad kun nges can zhig yin dgos pa lta bu red/spyir bod yul gyi char chu 'bab yun 'bab stangs dang / nyi 'od 'phro tshad 'phro yun kun zhing las thon skyed rgya cher spel bar 'tsham po med pas/tshan rtsal mthon pos zhing ra'i khor yug gi rgyun ldan gnas tshul la gzhig nas nyi 'od dang char chu bkol spyod dang sngon 'gog byed dgos pa ma zad/ chu glog 'dren spel nus pa'i zhing ra gsar bzo byas te/ zhing las thon skyed byed yun ring du gtong bar 'bad rgyu de bas kyang gnad tu 'khel ba zhig yin/'dir brjod pa'i tshan rtsal zhes pa ni thabs shes grung bo'am blo rtsal 'jon por go dgos pa las/ deng seng 'byor ldan rgyal khab kyis gsar du bzo bskrun byas pa'i ched bkol 'phrul chas mang po spyod dgos par bshad pa min/ 81

nga tshor sngon thon 'phrul chas de 'dra 'dren pa'i stobs 'byor med la/ bkol mkhas kyi lag rtsal mi sna'ang mang po yod nges min/ 'on kyang / mi ring bar 'phrul chas de 'dra bkol 'dren dang / tha na bzo spel byas nas zhing las deng rabs can du bsgyur ba'i 'char gzhi dang / snying stobs kyang yod dgos/(2)zhing las thon rdzas tshong ra'i dgos mkho dang khor yug cha rkyen la bstun nas 'debs 'dzugs bya dgos/ na ning nas btab na da lo'ang nas 'debs dgos pa'i nges ba gtan nas med la/ nas ma yin pa zhig 'debs dgos ba'i nges ba'ang med/(3)zhing las thon skyed yod byad ji 'dra sngon thon yod na/ thon skyed 'phel rgyas kyang de tsam mgyogs po yod pas/ thon skyed yo byad glog shugs can dang / 'phrul chas can/ deng rabs can bcas su bsgyur thabs byed rgyu zhing las thon skyed la gsar brje yong ba'i cha rkyen dang po yin pas/ spyi tshogs kyi ngal rtsol thon skyed nus shugs de tshan rig thon skyed nus shugs kyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas gtong bar 'bad dgos/ de min glog chas spyad na rnam rtog langs ba dang / 'phrul chas spyad na than bltas yin pa/ deng rabs can la bdud kyi cho 'phrul zer ba lta bu'i lta ba rnying rul rgyun 'khyongs byed kyang mi 'os bar 'dod/bzhi/ zhing las lag rtsal mi sna gso skyong bya dgos/tshan rig rig gnas gsar skrun byed mkhan mi yin la/ bkol spyod byed mkhan yang mi rang nyid las med/ tshan rig rig gnas ci tsam sngon thon yod na/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyang de tsam mgyogs myur ldan pa lo rgyus kyis nga 82

tshor bden dpang byas zin/ bod la mtshon na/ tshan rig dar rgyas de spyi tshogs dngos dang rgyang thag ha cang ring po yod pas/ spyi tshogs kyi stobs 'byor yang rgyal khab dang mi rigs gang la bsdur yang rjes lus yin pas/zhing las lag rtsal mi sna gso skyong dang gdan 'dren blo 'dri byas te tshan rtsal mkhas pos zhing las dar spel dang do dam 'jon po byed rgyu'ang zhing las thon skyed 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i thabs shes bzang po zhig yin/mdor na/ krung dbyang gi mdzub khrid 'og gam spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor gnas tshul la gzhig nas khyim tshang dang khyim tshang ngam ru khag dang ru khagatsho ba dang tsho ba/ zhang dang zhang / rdzong dang rdzong / tha na khul dang khul sogs rim pa so sos phan tshun mnyam 'brel byas te/ 'char gzhi dang mthun sgril/ snying stobs yod pa'i sgo nas rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ lag rtsal mi sna gso skyong dang gdan zhu/ sngon thon 'phrul chas nyo ba/ zhing ra rgya bskyed gtong ba/chu glog drangs 'dren/ sa gshis sgyur bkod/ 'bras bzang stod bsngags/do dam mthor 'degs bcas kyis zhing las dar spel dang / zhing las dar spel la phan pa'i khe las gsar 'dzugs sogs kyi thabs bkod rgyun 'khyongs byas na/ bod kyi zhing las thon skyed 'phel rgyas gtong srol med pa zhig kyang gtan nas min par 'dod/sa bcad gnyis pa/ bod kyi deng rabs 'brog las spel thabs/ 'brog las thon skyed ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i 'byung khungs gtso bo zhig yin/ lhag par du bdag gnyer ba'i bsam blo'i go rtogs dang / 83

tshan rig lag rtsal/ sgrig 'dzugs do dam bcas kyi tshad mthon po yod tshe/zas gos dang tshong las/ khe las/ 'grim 'grul kun gyi tshad mtho'i rgyu cha 'don sprod byed nus pa'i thon khungs gzhi rgya che zhing phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ yong 'bab mang la/ 'gro gron nyung ba/ dka' tsheg chung ba/brtan zhing brling ba'i thon sgo zhig yin cing / bdag gnyer ba de las ldog tshe/dka' tsheg che la/ yong 'bab nyung ba/ ha cang thabs rdugs gi 'tsho chas tsam las 'don mi thub pa'i thon las zhig yin/ bod khul gyi rtsa thang rgya che zhing /chu mang ba sogs 'brog las thon skyed rgya cher spel bar 'tsham po yod kyang /deng rabs can gyi 'brog las thon skyed dang bsdur na da dung ha cang rjes lus yin pas/ phyugs las 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu'ang bod rigs phyug 'gyur yong ba'i thabs lam gtso gras zhig yin par 'dod/gcig spang ljongs legs bcos dang do dam byed dgos/spang ljongs ni phyugs las kyi rtsa ba'i 'tsho rten yin/ phyugs las thon skyed 'phel rgyas gtong bar nges bar du spang ljongs kyi cha rkyen 'dzoms po yod dgos pas/ spangs ljongs srung skyob dang bsgyur bkod/ rgya bskyed btang nas deng rabs can gyi 'brog las khor yug 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu shin tu gal che yin/ rtsa 'dzugs dang 'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas rtsi shing 'debs 'dzugs dang / chu 'dren rdzas 'don gyis spang thang bye thang du 'gyur bzhin par sngon 'gog byed rgyu mig sngar bod kyi mdun du lhags pa'i kha tsha dgos gtug gi bya ba zhig red snyam/ byi long dang a bra/ byi ba/ nod 'bu dag gi 'phel tshad lo bzhin mang du 'gro bzhin 'dug pa 'di rang red/ da lta nas bod yul gyi sgang 84

gzhung kun du byi long gi sa 'bur dang a bra'i khung ba/ byi ba'i sa khung sogs nag thar re/ a bra dang byi ba skya thar re/ spang ljongs kyi gnod 'bu nag leb be/ 'bu rkon dang sman rkon gyis slog shul nag gor rer 'dug pa'i rnam pa ha las dgos pa zhig red/ 'di ltar rang shugs su bzhag tshe/ bod kyi yul khams mi ring bar bye thang du 'gyur nges ma red dam snyam pa zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes yong / yang cig lab na/ kho bo chung dus/ ru dgun sar 'bab skabs sgang gzhung gang sar song rung / rtswa thang nas sbed res kyi rtse mo rtsed thub cing / da lta rkang mgo'ang nub mi thub pas/ gter rdzas sngogs 'don dang / sman sna sna mang 'thus bas yin nam/ rtswa sa'i grub rdzas gzhan zhig 'chor gyi yod pa yin 'dod kyi yod/gnyis/ rtswa sna 'debs gnyer khe las 'dzugs dgos/sngon thon rgyal khab dag gis phyugs las nyams myong bsdu len dang tshan rig gis dpyad zhib nan pos 'debs 'dzugs byas shing / phan 'bras mngon par gsal ba'i rtswa sna mang po 'dren spel dang bzo 'debs byas te/ phyug las dpal 'byor mgyogs myur dar rgyas gtong bar thabs bkod legs po 'then dgos/ lhag par du bod kyi khor yug dang gnam gshis kyi dbang gis rang byung rtswa chu'i thon khungs kho nar brten na/ ‘‘dbyar kha rgyag cing ston kha tsho'ang /dgun kha skam zhing dpyid kha 'chi ba'i’’gnas tshul bcos mi thub pa ma zad/tshan rig dang mthun pa'i phyugs las myur spel lam lugs las 'gal rkyen/rtswa sna de rigs 'debs 'dzugs dang 'tshol sdud bya rgyu ha cang gal che 'dod/le'u gong mar zhus zin pa ltar bod yul gyi rtswa sman sogs ma bcos rgyu cha 85

gang rung gi rang byung thon khungs phun sum tshogs pas/ phyugs las gnas bab bzang ba'i yul lung dag gis nub phyogs sgo 'byed chen mo'i go skabs bzang po dam 'dzin byas nas khyim tshang dang khyim tshang ngam/ ru khag dang ru khag gam/ tsho ba dang tsho ba'am/ zhang dang zhang ngam/ rdzong dang rdzong ngam/khul dang khul so sos rang thad dam mnyam 'brel gyis 'char 'god dang rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ rtsa sna de rigs 'debs bzo byed pa'i khe las dang / 'dren btsong tshong rwa 'dzugs gnyer byed pa dang / phyugs sman ched gnyer ba dang phyugs las ched mkhas mi sna gso skyong dang nang 'dren byas nas phyug las deng rabs can dang / ched gnyer can du bsgyur thabs byed rgyu'ang bod kyi dpal 'byor dar spel gtong ba'i rtsa lag rmang gzhir gyur ba zhig yin/gsum/ phyugs rgyud legs sgyur dang do dam tshad mthor gtong dgos/rgyal khab bam mi rigs gang zhig yin kyang / phyugs las dar spel gtong bar rang rang gi khor yug dang bstun nas/ phyugs rigs gdams gses dang phyugs rgyud legs sgyur byed pa'ang ha cang gal chen yin/ de'i phyir/ phyugs rgyud kyi skyed rgya dang bal khul gyi spus ka sogs phyogs mang po'i thad nas 'dem sgrig ma nor ba byas rjes/ rang rang gi tshan rig lag rtsal dang rtswa rwa'i che chung ltar/ grangs 'bor nges can gyi phyugs las thon skyed do dam nan tan byas tshe/ phyugs gnyer ba'i ngal rtsol 'gro song je nyung du gtong thub pa ma zad/ 'gro song nyung zhing yong 'bab mang pa'i 'brog las thon skyed rgya cher spel thub nges yin/ dper na/ deng sang phyugs las sngon thon rgyal 86

khab dag gis phyugs grangs stong phrag du ma mi gcig gis 'tsho skyong thub pa dang /chu tshod gcig re'i nang 'bri dang ba mo brgya phrag 'ga' re mi gcig gis bzho thub pa/ zog lug brgya phrag du ma'i khul rtsid mi gcig gis 'breg thub pa lta bu red/bzhi/ phyugs las thon skyed dang 'brel ba'i bzo grwa spel 'dzugs bya dgos/spyir phyugs las thon skyed ni zhing las dang / bzo las/ nags las sogs kyi thon skyed dang thun mong ma yin pa'i las sgo zhig yin pa smos med yin mod/ phyugs las thon skyed kyi 'phel rgyas de las ldog te thon las gzhan dag dang bral thabs med pa zhig yin/ phyugs grangs mang du 'phel nas/mar dang phyur ba/ 'o ma/ sha rus pa/ paṭa pa/ bal dang khul rtsid sogs kyis tshong rwa dang 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho skong thub pa tsam gyis yid tshim chog shes skyes tshe/ phyugs las chen po'i rang bzhin gyi dar spel dang yong 'bab yod mi srid/ de bas/ nges par du gong smos ltar phan tshun mnyam 'brel sgos phyugs las thon rdzas kyi las snon bzo grwa mang po 'dzugs gnyer byas te/ 'dzam gling ngam rgyal khab rang bzhin gyi zas gos spyod chas sna tshogs gsar bzo byas nas thon rdzas je mang dang tshong ra rgya skyed gtong ba'ang phyugs las deng rabs can dang 'byor phyug can du bsgyur ba'i bgrod lam gcig pu yin zhes smra chog chog yin/mdor na/ phyugs las gnyer stangs thabs chag dang rjes lus/ dka' tshegs che zhing thon rdzas nyung ba/ 'gro song mang zhing yong 'bab nyung ba'i srol 87

rgyun phyugs las nas deng rabs can nam tshan rig dang mthun pa'i phyogs su goms gang mdun spos kyis dar spel bya dgos pa las/ phyugs zog 'ga' dang mnyam du sa dkyogs lung khug re nas phyugs zog gi 'tsho ba rol bar u tshugs mtha' 'khyongs byed pa ni deng rabs kyi dus dang mi mthun zhing / phan pa dang dgos ba'ang med la/ don chung don chen du bsgyur ba kho na las ma 'das snyam/sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi deng rabs nags las spel thabs/mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i khrod/nags las thon skyed kyis med du mi rung ba'i gnas bab gal chen bzung yod/dper na/ gna' nas khang ba dang / mda' gzhu/ gri mdung sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad sna tshogs bzo ba dang / lhag par du mi'i rigs kyi shes rig nyams myong gong 'phel dang tshan rig lag rtsal rgya cher dar ba'i 'gros dang bstun nas/ snum dang mngar rigs/ sman sna/ shog bu/ zam pa/ ku shu/ 'gyig ras/ khang brtsegs sogs 'tsho ba'i mkho chas gsar ba sna tshogs bzo thub kyi yod pa ma zad/ rlung shugs 'gog pa dang / spang thang bye mar 'gyur ba sngon 'gog mkha' dbugs gtsang bzo/ skam 'gyur chu gnod sel ba sogs khor yug srung skyob dang legs bcos thad la'ang phan nus shugs chen thebs kyi yod pas/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i nags las dpal 'byor dar spel gtong rgyu yang deng rabs can mngon 'gyur byed pa'i rtsa ba'i cha rkyen zhig yin/ 88

gcig nags tshal srung skyob dang do dam legs po bya dgos/rang byung nags tshal srung skyob byed pa ni don dngos khor yug srung skyob byed pa yin la/ khor yug srung skyob byed pa ni don dngos mi'i rigs rang nyid srung skyob byed pa yin pas/ rang byung nags tshal thon khungs 'dzoms po yod pa'i yul lung dag gis 'brel yod sde khag dang mnyam 'brel gyis nags tshal rku breg dang rnyog bregs/ me 'chor ba/ jag rkun gyi yul du 'gyur ba sogs kyi gnas tshul sngon 'gog dang / bzang 'dzugs ngan 'dor dang rin gong tshad ldan/ spyi phan bkol spyod byed pa sogs rang rgyal gyi 〈 rang byung nags tshul srung skyob dang bkol spyod byed stangs〉kyi bca' khrims ltar rgyun ldan rang bzhin gyis srung skyob dang khrims ldan rang bzhin gyis do dam legs po byed dgos/gnyis/ khor yug sngo ljang can du bsgyur bar 'bad brtson bya dgos/mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus la phyir lta byas tshe/ dang thog ri lung dang nags tshal du 'tsho sdod byas pa'i gna' mi tsho thabs brgya jus stong gis bde thang dang grong khyer du spo bar 'bad brtson byas yod cing / da lta a me ri kha gtso byas pa'i sngon thon rgyal khab dag gis grong khyer du nags tshal 'debs 'dzugs dang / 'byor ldan pa tsho nags khrod dang ri lung / dben gnas bcas su spo 89

bar hur brtson dang dga' bo byed bzhin pa ci'i phyir yin nam/ tag tag dga' phyogs tsam las rgyu mtshan dang gnas lugs ci yang med pa zhig yin srid dam zhe na/ nags rigs 'debs 'dzugs byas te/ 'tsho gnas khor yug sngo ljang can du sgyur thabs byed pa ni mi'i sems khams bde 'jags dang /khor yug srung skyob/ mkha' dbugs gtsang bzo/ rlung chu'i gnod sel sogs phan nus che zhing tshan rig dang mthun pa'i thon las byed sgo zhig yin pas so/bod mi tshos zhing ra bye sar gyur ba'am sdod gnas chu yis bsnubs pa sogs kyi rang byung gnod 'tshe la thabs bkod ci yang mi 'then par ‘‘dgra ya med me chu gnyis yin’’zhes yin yin 'grig 'grig gi gtam re bshad nas rang byung gnod par mgo 'dogs gnya' sgur byas te sdod kyi 'dug mod/ don dngos de ltar ma yin pas/ nags rigs 'debs 'dzugs dang dar spel btang nas rang byung 'jigs pa 'gog sel dang 'tsho gnas khor yug srung skyob byed dgos pa ma zad/ rtsa 'dzugs dang 'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas sa rgod dam bye thang du gyur zin pa'i yul lung dag tu'ang yid 'ong sngo ljang ldan pa'i khor yug bzo skrun byed par 'bad dgos 'dod/gsum/ nags las bzo grwa 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos/rgyal khab dang mi rigs phyug 'gyur yong ba'am spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba/ yang na mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad mthor 'degs yong bar/ nags las thon skyed kyang nges par du dar spel gtong dgos yod/de bzhin nags las thon skyed dar spel gtong bar yang nags las bzo grwa dang shing rigs las snon bzo grwa/ nags las dang 'brel ba'i khe las mang po 90

nges par du 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos 'dod/de'i phyir/ bod yul gyi nags rigs thon khungs 'dzoms po yod pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog nags las shes ldan mi sna gso skyong dang / ma dngul mnyam sdud kyis nags rigs gso 'debs (chu glog drang nas skye yun ring du gtong ba sogs)dang / khyim las las snon/ shog bu sdeb bzo/ mngar sna las sbyor/shing sman dang shing tog 'debs gnyer/ nags tshal gling ka phye ba sogs kyi las rigs mang po sger gzhung gang rung gis gtso gnyer byas te/ nags las thon skyed thad nas bod dmangs 'tsho ba'i longs spyod phun tshogs dang /dpal 'byor spyi'i 'phel tshad myur du gtong bar brtson dgos pa ma zad/nags las deng rabs can dang ched nyer can du dar rgyas gtong bar de bas kyang 'bad pa hur thag bya dgos 'dod/mdor na/ deng sang bod yul phal cher bye sar su 'gyur gyi yod pa dang /sa cha la lar chu chad than skyon yong bzhin pa/ la lar chu log char log yong bzhin pa/ rtsi shing skyed tshad lo bzhin mar chags bzhin pa/ mi nad phyugs nad je mang je ljid du 'gro bzhin pa yod tshad khrims 'gal gyis nags tshal gtub gcod dang / gter kha sngog 'don byas par 'brel ba dam zab yod rkyen/ nags las thon skyed dar spel gtong ba'ang rang mi rigs sam rgyal khab spyi'i ma 'ongs pa'i 'jigs nyen zhig la sngon 'gog byed pa ma red dam bsam gyi yod/ 91

sa bcad bzhi pa/ bod kyi deng rabs nya las spel thabs/nya las ni chu gnas srog chags (gtso bo nya rigs dang sbal rigs)gso skyong dang las snon bkol spyod byed pa'i thon skyed las sgo zhig yin la/ rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi gal che'i grub cha zhig kyang yin/ de'i phyir/ nya las thon skyed kyang med pa nas yod pa dang / zhor las nas ched las/ srol rgyun nas deng rabs can du bsgyur bar 'bad brtson bya rgyu'ang bod kyi dpal 'byor dar spel gtong ba'i ma lag gnad du 'khel ba zhig yin par 'dod kyi yod/thog mar mtsho mtshe'u'am/ chu che chung gi rang byung thon khungs 'dzoms po yod rgyu nya las thon skyed spel ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen nam/ rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi yin/ gong zhus ltar bod du nya las thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod cing /nya las gnyer mkhan ha cang nyung nyung yin pa ma zad/ da dung lha sa'i 'jun sde tsho sogs gcig gnyis re yod par yang ‘‘nya mo stong sdig’’zhes sdig mkhan nam/ ( phyi gling ba zhig gis ‘‘ya mtshar 'os pa zhig la/ bod mi tshos sems can 'jigs po stag gzig sogs gsod par zhen snang spu tsam med pa dang /sems can che ba g.yag dang shwa ba sogs kyi sha za bar dog snang tsam yang med pa lta bu zhig yin cing / de las ldog te/ sems can gnyom po 'bu rigs sogs gsod par sems gting nas 'dzem shing / sems can chung ba nya rigs (rgya mtsho'i nang gi nya rigs che gras mi ston)sogs kyi sha za bar ha cang dogs nges yin zhes pa lta bu zhig ma red dam/) tha shal du bgrang nas mthong chung dang ‘‘ nya ba/ mgar ba/ shing bzo’’ces go gnas dma' sar 'jog pa'i 92

chos lugs lta ba'am/ srol rgyun bsam blo rnying rul 'di dang 'di lta bu mang pos bod kyi dpal 'byor dar rgyas yong bar mig gis mthong rgyu dang / lag pas 'dzin rgyu med pa'i 'gog shugs drag po thebs kyi 'dug par snyam/gcig nya las shes rtogs mthor 'degs gtong dgos/‘‘chos lugs gcig snub dgos na/ nges bar du chos lugs gzhan zhig spel dgos’’zhes ba ltar/ spyi tshogs zhig gi lta ba rnying ba bcos sgyur byed par nges bar du gnas lugs ldan pa'i lta ba gsar ba spel ba dang / mngon sum tshad ma'i lag len gyis 'gog rgol byed dgos/ de'i phyir/ dang thog bod mi tshos nya sha za bar rnam rtog byed pa dang / nya las gnyer bar mthong chung byed pa sogs kyi lta ba'i 'byung rkyen btsal nas gnas lugs gsal 'debs dang gnad du 'khel ba'i 'bras ston bden dpang byed rgyu bod du nya las thon skyed spel ba'i rtsa ba'i nang gi rtsa ba dang / gtso bo'i nang gi gtso bo yin/ ngas bod yul du nya las thon skyed gnyer gyi med pa rang cag gi dkar yol nang gi bro bcud ldan la/ rin thang che ba'i zas sna gcig gzhan la rin med du ster gyi yod pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas khrod kyi gyong gud tshabs chen zhig red 'dod kyi yod/spyir nya las ni 'gro song nyung zhing / yong 'bab mang pa'i thon las zhig yin/ spyi tshogs dpal 'byor mthor 'degs dang mi dmangs 'tsho ba 'byor phyug yong ba'i 'phel rim khrod kyang go gnas gal chen bzung yod/ dper na/deng sang rgyal khab mang che ba'i chu gnas srog chags (gtso bo nya dang shā/ sbal rigs sogs)gso gnyer byas pa'i yong 'bab de 'debs 'dzugs thon las 93

yong 'bab las mtho pa lta bu'am/ nya dang shā sogs chu gnas srog chags kyi sha nang du spri rdzas (ྈdzeezla)'dus tshad mang rkyen/ lus phung gso ba'i nus ba bzang po yod/ mi re'i nyin gcig gi zas kyi nang du spri rdzas khe 60—100yod dgos bar/ phag sha zos tshe/ rgya ma gcig za dgos kyi yod la/ bye'am 'bras zos tshe/ rgya ma gnyis za dgos cing / nya rigs zos tshe/ srang brgyad las za dgos kyi med pa lta bu red /gnyis/ nya las do dam tshad mthor gtong dgos/spyir rgyal khrims kyi rgyab skyor dang / bsam blo'i mdzub ston/ sgrig gzhi'i bkod 'dom bzang ba'i spyi tshogs rtsa 'dzugs gang dang gang 'dra zhig yin yang 'dod don rgya chen 'grub nges yin/ nya las kyang de las ma 'das bas/yod tshad dar rgyas la phyogs pa'i rang rgyal gyi bskal ba bzang po 'di dang /lhag par du nub khul sgo 'byed chen mo'i go skabs bzang po 'di dam 'dzin byas nas/ mi sger ram/ zhang / rdzong / khul so so'i rang yul rang spel byed pa dang chabs gcig nya las khor yug srung skyob dang 'dzugs skrun/ phyi la 'grem tshong dang bsgrags spel/ nang gi gso jus dang / sgrig gzhi so so dam tshags rgyun 'khyongs byas nas nya las thon skyed dar rgyas gtong dgos/ ma gzhi rang rigs nang khul du nyo mkhan dang bstod mkhan gcig kyang med par gzhan la 'grem tshong gi las sna kho na gnyer dgos cing / blo sems mi gnyom par thabs brgya jus stong gis ma 'ongs bar zog lug phag gsum gyi sha dang /tsha sgog g.yer gsum gyi rdzas/ mar chur snum gsum gyi bcud/ gro nas sran gsum gyi bye tsam gyis grub pa'i bod zas la kha snon gcig rgyag thub pa'i sems 94

shugs dang bsam blo yod dgos 'dod/gsum/ nya las khe las 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos/zhing las dang phyugs las/ nags las dang nya las sogs kyi thon las gang zhig 'phel rgyas rgya cher gtong dgos na/ nges bar du thon lase de rigs kyi khe las dang / las snon bzo grwa/ 'grim spel tshong rwa sogs 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos yod/ de'i phyir/ gong smos ltar nya las lag rtsal mi sna dang / ched mkhas mi sna gso skyong dang nang 'dren byas nas nya sha skam pa dang / bsnyol ba/btso ba/ bsngo ba/ bcos bsdebs byedapa sogs kyi khe las dang / las snon bzo grwa/ gso khang / tshong rwa bcas 'dzugs gnyer byas te/ bod dmangs dpal 'byor dar rgyas dang / spyi tshogs longs spyod sna 'dzoms/ nya las thon skyed la gsar brje gtong ba bcas kyi byas rjes rlabs chen 'jog par brtson 'os 'dod/sa bcad lnga pa/ bod kyi deng rabs bzo las spel thabs/mthon po khri thog gi bla ma dpon po/ dma' mo gdan steng gi zhing ba 'brog pa/ phyi yi 'khyams po ldom po/ nang gi jag pa rkun ma/ tha na dgon mtha'i sprang po sprang mo sogs kyi bod mi su zhig yin cing / rang mi rigs 'di stobs 'byor ldan pa'i a me ru kha'i mi rigs lta bu zhig yin na mi 'dod mkhan dang mi dga' mkhan gcig kyang yod mi srid/ 'on kyang / a me ri kha 95

ji ltar stobs 'byor ldan par gyur ba dang / rang cag ci'i phyir de ltar ma gyur bar rjes lus 'byor med chags par bsam blo zhib gtong dang / gnad don zhib 'tshol byed mkhan brgya'i nang na gcig dang gnyis yod na'ang mang tsam red/ da dung de gcig gnyis kyi nang du'ang lag len khrod 'dod don rtsod len byed thub mkhan gyi gsar brje ba phal cher stong cha'i gcig tsam yin tshod red/ de'i phyir/ nga tsho 'di ltar 'byor med rmongs 'thoms su gyur ba red 'dod kyi yod/bzo las ni rang byung thon khungs sngog 'don dang / ma bcos rgyu char las snon byed pa'i spyi tshogs thon sgo zhig yin la/ thon las gzhan dag la thon skyed yo byad dang / lag rtsal sgrig chas/ ma bcos rgyu cha sogs mkho sprod byed thub pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i mkho dngos phun sum tshogs pa bzo spel byed pa sogs rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi gtso khrid dang srog shing lta bu yin rkyen/ rgyal khab bam mi rigs gang zhig yin yang rgyal dmangs stobs 'byor mtshon byed gtso bo bzo las yin pa smos med red/ bzo las thon skyed dar rgud kyis rgyal dmangs stobs 'byor la tshod 'dzin byed kyi yod/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs gang gis bzo las gnyer ba ci tsam yag po yod na/ mi rigs de'i 'phel rgyas kyang de ltar mgyogs nges yin/ gal te/ bzo las dar spel byed pa'i 'char 'god dam shes rtog la nor 'khrul byung tshe/ tag tag ‘‘glen pa 'chug na mtho gang dang / mkhas ba 'chug na 'dom gang ’’zhes ba ltar/ nyin zhag gam lo zla 'ga'i dus tshod stong zad btang ba tsam ma yin par/ lo rabs 'ga' phyir nur byas te/ dus rabs 'ga'i mdun lam bcad pa dang kun nas mtshungs bar 'dod kyi yod/ 96

bzo las kyi phan nus 'di ltar rgya che zhing dgos gal che stabs/ da lta nga tshos bzo las ji ltar dar spel gtong bar bsam dgos ba las/ don dngos bzo las dar spel gtong dgos min la dogs snang skye dgos med/ ngas bod yul kyi rang byung thon khungs dang / shes rig lag rtsal/ dpal 'byor chu tshad kun gyi phyogs nas bsam blo btang gin btang gin 'di ltar byed mi dgos sam 'dod kyi yod/gcig yul bstun bzo grwa 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos/'dzam gling ngam rgyal khab/ yang na mi rirges spyi'i rang bzhin gyi bzo grwa zhig 'dzugs gnyer bya bar rang byung thon khungs 'dzoms pa tsam gyis mi chog par ched gnyer shes ldan mi sna dang / ma dngul/ srid jus/ rtsa 'dzugs/'grim 'grul/ tshong rwa sogs kyi cha rkyen yang 'dzoms po yod dgos/ 'on kyang / bzo grwa 'dzugs pa la nges bar du rgya che ba'i bzo grwa 'dzugs dgos don med par bzo grwa che 'bring chung gsum gnyer chog pa yin/ da dung che ba btsugs na de ltar khe phan bzang ba dang / chung chung btsugs na de ltar phan khe chung ba'i nges ba'ang med/ de'i phyir/ mdo dbus khams gsum gyi ri lung so so na gnas ba'i thun mong dang mi sger su zhig yin kyang / rang yul gyi ma bcos rgyu cha'i thon khungs dang / 'grim 'grul/ tshong rwa'i gzhi rgya/ ma dngul/lag rtsal bcas kyi khor yug cha rkyen dang bstun nas bzo grwa'i dpang yig nyo ba'am slong ba/ g.yar ba/ bskyi ba/ gsar bzo bcas byas te/ rang mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i lag rtsal bzo las dang / las snon bzo las/'phrul chas bzo las/ 'dzugs skrun bzo las/ rdzas 'gyur bzo las/ 97

gter 'don bzo las mang po 'dzugs gnyer byas nas deng rabs can du brtson pa dang / zhing phyugs las rigs dar spel byas nas deng rabs can du brtson pa gnyis sdur tshe/ g.yag dang rlung 'khor gyi mgyogs tshad 'gran pa lta bu zhig ma red dam bsam gyi yod/ lhag par du/ da lta glog rdul rtsis 'khor bkol nas 'dzam gling ngam rgyal khab rang bzhin gyi nyo tshong bya chog rkyen/ bzo las can gyi spyi tshogs gsar ba zhig 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu rang mi rigs deng rabs can gyi lam du bskyod pa'i bya thabs gcig pu yin par 'dod kyi yod/gnyis/ bdag gnyer do dam sgrig gzhi dam tshags yod dgos/thon skyed las sgo gang zhig yin yang do dam sgrig khrims dam tshags yod dgos pa ma zad/ da dung gnas lugs yod pa'i sgo nas jus gzhi lag bstar byas ba rgyun ldan dang 'dra mnyam yin dgos/ gal te/ bzo grwa che chung gang rung zhig gi dngul bkol stangs tshad ldan min pa dang / las mi 'dra mnyam min pa/ thon rdzas bdag gnyer nan po med pa zhig byung tshe/ bzo grwa de 'phel rgyas byung nas rgyal khab bam sa gnas mi rigs la phan pa'i re ba med pa ma zad/ bzo grwa de ni mgo lus gang rung zhig tu rul dri 'thul bzhin pa'i khrims 'gal gyi bzo grwa zhig yin srid ces lab kyang mi chog pa med par 'dod/de'i phyir/ las mi'i grangs tshad tshod 'dzin byed rgyu rtsa ba'i rmang gzhir bzung nas thon rdzas spus ka je mthor gtong ba'i jus 'god lag len dang / rang 'gan rang 'khur gyi lam lugs gsar gtod/ bya ba dang gla phog bab stun/las mi'i slob gso rtsa ba'i sngon 'gror 'dzin pa sogs 'gan dbang phan 98

gsum rtsa bar bzung nas phyogs yongs bcos sgyur dang phyi phyogs sgo 'byed bcas byas te/ bzo las do dam chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong rgyu'ang bzo grwa de 'phel rgyas dang bod dmangs phyug 'gyur yong ba'i thog ma'i cha rkyen zhig yin par snang /gsum/ mnyam 'brel khe las btsugs nas bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed rgyun 'khrongs bya dgos/da lta/ tshan rig 'phrul chas gong 'phel 'gro bzhin pa'i sgang yin la/'dzam gling 'phrul chas can du 'gyur bzhin pa'i sgang yang yin stabs/ skar cha re re'i nang 'jig rten bcos bsgyur thengs re byed kyi yod la/ bcos bsgyur re res 'dzam gling sgo 'byed mnyam 'brel byed dgos ba bden dpang byed kyi yod ces lab kyang mi mthun pa ci yang med par 'dod/ de'i phyir/dar rgyas la re ba'i las rigs ci zhig yin yang 'dzam gling 'gro phyogs dang bstun dgos ba smos med red/ khe las la mtshon na/ lhag par du de ltar yin/khe las gang zhig yin cing / tshong rwa'i gzhi rgya dang dgos mkhos khe las de 'phel rgyas 'gro min gyi mdun lam gtan 'khel byed kyi yod/ tshong rwa'i gzhi khyon rgya skyed gtong bar nges bar du khe las gzhan dag dang mnyam 'brel sgo 'byed byed dgos/ bod la mtshon na/ ma dngul nyung zhing lag rtsal zhan stabs/ thog mar rang rigs nang khul gyi khe las che chung 'ga' re mnyam 'brel byas te/ ma bcos rgyu cha dang / lag rtsal/ tshong rwa sogs bskyi g.yar btsong gsum gyis gtso khrid khe las mnyam 'dzugs bya dgos pa dang / de'ang phyi'i grong khyer ram rgyal khab gyi sngon thon khe las dag dang mnyam 'brel byas 99

nas tshong rwa'i gzhi khyon rgya skyed gtong dgos/tshong rwa'i dgos mkho rgya cher skong thabs bya ba'ang khe las kyi mdun lam dang 'brel ba'i gnad don cig yin/ de bas/ tshong rwa'i dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i dngos rdzas thon skyed bya rgyu khe las kyi babs 'gan lta bur gyur yod/'dzam gling ngam rgya che'i tshong rwa'i dgos mkho skong dgos na/ nges par du dus rabs dang bstun dgos 'dug deng rabs 'dzam gling ni gsar bar phyogs pa zhig yin pas/ nges par du dus rabs dang mthun pa'i dngos rdzas gsar ba thon skyed bya thub pa'i bcos bsgyur byed dgos yod/ 'on kyang / thon rdzas la la ni rang mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog gsar bcos bya rgyu'ang ha cang gtso gnad che ba zhig yin par 'dodā kyi yod/bzhi/ shes ldan mi sna nang 'dren dang gso skyong bya dgos/'dzam gling deng rabs can ni tshan rig lag rtsal las byung ba yin la/tshan rig lag rtsal ni shes ldan mi snas gsar skrun byas pa yin/ rgyal khab bam mi rigs/ yang na khe las sogs gang du shes ldan mi sna mang po yod pa de yi tshan rig lag rtsal sngon thon dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas de tsam mgyogs po yod pa lo rgyus kyis bden dpang byas yod pa 'di rang red/ bod rigs 'phel rgyas gtong ba'ang chos nyid dam bgrod lam 'di las bda' mi rung /da dung bod kyi yig rmongs ba'i grangs 'bor mang ba dang / tshan rig lag rtsal ched gnyer ba de bas kyang nyung nyung yin stabs/ lhag par du shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bya dgos 'dod/khe las zhig la mtshon na/ lag rtsal mi sna'i ched las yon tshad mthon po 100

yod dgos ba ma zad/ las ka ba'i bsam blo'i go rtogs kyang mthon po yod dgos/ lag rtsal mi sna ci tsam mkhas pa yod na/ deng rabs tshan rig dang mthun la chong rwa'i dgos mkho skong thub pa'i thon rdzas gsar ba mang po bzo skrun byed thub nges yin cing / las ka ba'i bsam blo'i go rtogs mtho tsam med tshe/ thon rdzas kyi spus ka dang nyo tshong / 'gro rgyug gang thad nas rnyog dra mang po yong gi red/ de'i phyir/ khe las so sos tshan rig lag rtsal mi sna dang /las rigs ched gnyer mi sna/ bdag gnyer do dam mi sna sogs kyi shes ldan mi sna mang po sa/so skyong dang nang 'dren bya rgyu'ang khe las rlung 'khor gyi snum sgo lta bu yin/mdor na/ sa gnas sam mi rigs zhig gi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba 'byor phyug ldan dgos na/ nges par du deng rabs can gyi khe las mang po 'dzugs skrun bya dgos yod/ 'on kyang / khe las de'ang rang byung thon khungs dang /dpal 'byor gnas bab/ ma dngul/ shes ldan mi sna/ chong rwa'i gzhi rgya bcas kyi gnas tshul dang bstun nas 'dzugs gnyer bya dgos 'dod/sa bcad drug pa/ yul bskor las rigs spel thabs/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis ba byung rjes/ nub gling gtsos tshan rig lag rtsal mgyogs myur dar rgyas phyin nas spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gong 'phel dang mi dmangs 'tsho ba 'dzoms po byung ste/ mi rnams kyi dngos po'i longs spyod yid tshim pa byung ba dang bstun nas bsam pa'i longs spyod 'tshol snyeg byed pa'i mtho rlabs zhig bslangs stabs/ yul skor las rigs de ma skul rang 'gul gyis 'phel rgyas byung zhing / rim bzhin mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i cha 101

shas zhig tu gyur/rgyal spyi'i yul skor rtsa 'dzugs kyis sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/ 1950lor 'dzam gling yul skor mi 'bor khri 2500tsam dang / yul skor yong 'bab a sgor dung phyir 21tsam yin mod/ 1990lor mi 'bor dung phyur 4tsam dang yul skor yong 'bab a sgor dung phyur 2650tsam du 'phel rgyas phyin zhing /1991lor 'dzam gling yul skor mi 'bor dung phyir 4lhag dang / yul skor yong 'bab a sgor dung phyir 2780tsam du 'phel 'dug la/ ched gnyer mkhas bas mngon rtsis byas bar/ 2000lor rgyal spyi'i yul skor yongs 'bab a sgor dung phyir 8900tsam du slebs nges red ces gsungs yod/rgyal khab bam mi rigs gang zhig yin cing / yul skor las rigs 'phel rgyas gtong bar nges bar du phun sum tshogs pa'i yul skor thon khungs zhig yod dgos/ bod la mtshon na/ mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i rang byung yul ljongs dang / mi lo stong phrag mang po'i rig gnas lo rgyus/ gting zab ngo mtshar ldan pa'i chos lugs khor yug khyad du 'phags pa'i mis bzos mdzes ljongs sogs yul skor thon khungs ha cang phun sum tshogs po yod cing /'grim 'grul/ gsal bsgrags/ gnam gshis/ ched mkhas mi sna nyung ba bcas kyi dbang gis yul skor las rigs de tsam 'phel rgyas phyin mi 'dugabod rang skyong ljongs la mtshon na 1980lor phyi rgyal yul skor mi 'bor 1 059tsam las mi 'dug 1987lor yul skor mi 'bor 43 500tsam dang /yul skor yong 'bab sgor khri 3 1355tsam dang / 1992lor mi 'bor khri 2 6tsam dang / yong 'bab sgor dung phyir 117las mi 'dug o si khru'o li ya mtshon na/ rgyal khab spyi'i mi 'bor khri 700tsam red/ 1984lor rgyal 102

phyi'i yul skor ba khri 1511 tsam sne len byas 'dug yul skor yongs 'bab a sgor dung phyir 52 3 tsam dang / rgyal dmangs thon skyed spyi sdom gyi brgya cha'i 7 8zin 'dug pas/ khong tshos ‘‘yul skor las rigs med na/ o ti li yod mi srid’’ces bshad kyi yod/ de'i phyir/ bod kyi spyi sger su zhig yin yang yul skor las rigs 'phel rgyas gtong bar 'char 'god dang lag len byed 'os pa'i tshad du slebs 'dug snyam gyi yod/ gsham du rang gi 'dod tshul tsam bkod na/gcig yul skor las rigs kyi shes rtogs je mthor gtong dgos/yul skor las rigs ni phyi 'brel las sgo kher rkyang zhig min par/ las rigs gzhan dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i spyi tshogs dpal 'byor las sgo zhig yin/ mi rnams kyis‘‘dud med bzo grwa'am gzugs med phyir 'dren/dmangs khrod phyi 'brel’’bcas su 'bod kyi yod/ ljongs rgyu las rigs dar spel legs po byung tshe/ las rigs gzhan dag gi 'phel rgyas la'ang shugs rkyen chen po thebs nges bas/ yul skor las rigs kyis bod ljongs rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor khrod bzung ba'i gnas bab gsal bor rtogs dgos yod/bod yul gyi mkha' dbugs dwangs shing gtsang ba dang lo rgyus ring ba/rig gnas gting zab pa/ chos lugs khor yug khyad du mtshar ba/ yul ljongs mdzes sdug ldan pa sogs ljongs rgyu'i thon khungs phun sum tshogs pas/103

gnyis/ yul skor thon khungs srung skyob dang legs bcos bya dgos/da lta/ 'dzam gling yul skor ba'i grangs 'bor nyin re las nyin rer mang du 'gro bzhin yod pa ci'i phyir red/ khong tsho'i ma dngul dang chu tshod mang drag nas don med dmigs med kyis 'khyams bzhin pa zhig yin srid dam zhe na/ gtan nas min te/ khong tsho phal cher zas gos 'dzoms pa tsam tag tag yin srid/ lhag par du bod ljongs su 'byor ba'i yul skor ba tsho mi rigs 'dir rgyus lon dang / rig gnas zhib 'jug spyi tshogs brtag dpyad byed pa bcas bsam pa'i dpal yon 'tshol snyeg pa sha stag yin pa las/ phyug po spro gseng la phebs pa'am mthon po lta skor la phebs pa ha cang nyung nyung yin pas/ yul skor lte gnas so so'i rig gnas khyad chos srung skyob dang dgos nges grub cha legs bcos byed rgyu de yul skor las rigs kyi dar rgud dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa'i gnad don zhig yin par 'dod kyi yod/de'i phyir/ ljongs dang zhing chen/ khul rdzong so sos rang rang yul khongs kyi ljongs rgyu'i thon khungs so sor rtog dpyod zhib phra byas rjes/ 'grim 'grul sogs phyogs yongs kyi gnas bab la gzhig nas gzhir gyur thon khungs so sor blo 'god pa dang dngos po gang rung gi dgos mkho 'don spel byas te/srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyad chos gsal zhing deng rabs rig gnas kyi rnam pa dod pa'i gling ga dang / zhabs bro khang / za khang / ja khang / tshong rdzas/mgron khang / rtsed rwa/ sbrag khang / 'grim 'grul kun gyi thad nas yul skor ba'i re ba skong thub pa'i khor yug cha rkyen 'dzugs skrun byed pa sogs chung ba ri 105

nas che ba dang / sla mo nas dka' mor phyogs pa'i dmigs pas/ bod ljongs yul skor las sgo de rim bzhin rjes lus nas sngon thon dang / srol rgyun nas deng rabs bcas su 'phel rgyas gtong bar 'bad brtson bya dgos yod/gsum/ yul skor ched gnyer mi sna bsdu skyong legs po bya dgos/mi'i rigs byung ba nas bzung 'phel rgyas brtson gnyer byed bzhin yong yod tshod red/ lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang du/ dpa' bo dang mkhas ba tshos kyang 'phel rgyas kyi ched du tshe srog btang ba mang po red/ da lta da dung 'phel rgyas la 'bad brtson byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin pa 'di rang red/'phel rgyas kyis da gzod mi'i rigs la zhi bde dang spro skyid bskyal yong ba'i the tshom dang dogs snang su la'ang skye myong med par 'dod kyi yod/ 'on kyang /da lta'i gnas tshul la gzhig nas kho bos glen 'dang re rgyab tshe/ 'phel rgyas kyis da gzod mi'i rigs mu ge dang nad yams/ 'khrug rtsod/ 'jig nyen bcas kyi phyogs su 'khrid kyi mi 'dug gam bsam gyi 'dug gang ltar/'dzam gling mi dmangs kyis sngar bzhin 'phel rgyas la brtson gnyer byed bzhin 'dug pas/ nga tshos kyang rang nyid srung skyob dang 'dra mnyam gyi slad du 'phel rgyas la 'bad brtson mi byed thabs med du gyur yod/'phel rgyas kyi 'byung rtsa shes ldan mi snar 'khel yod pas/ las rigs so so'i shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu nga tsho 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen yin/ yul skor las rigs kyang de las ma 'das stabs/ yul skor ched nyer mi sna gso skyong dang gdan 'dren byas nas/ skad sgyur ba dang gsal 106

bshad pa/ khyab bsgrags pa/ do dam pa/ zhabs 'degs pa sogs kyi rtsa 'dzugs legs po bya rgyu yul skor las sgo dar spel gtong ba'i srog shing lta bu'am gzhi rtsa lta bur gyur yod/ skad sgyur bar byang cha med pa dang / 'go khrid kyi do dam bkod sgrig mi bzang ba/ zhabs 'degs pa'i rgyu spus mi legs pa zhig byung tshe/ yul skor thon khungs sogs cha rkyen gzhan dag ci 'dra bzang po yod cing / yul skor las sgo gtan nas 'phel rgyas 'gro mi nus rkyen/yul skor ched gnyer mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu ha cang gal chen red 'dod/bzhi/ yul skor khyab bsgrags rgya cher bya bar shugs snon bya dgos/yul skor khyab bsgrags rgya cher bya rgyu yul skor mi dmangs 'gugs 'dren byed pa'i thabs lam bzang shos yin la/ yul skor las rigs 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i thabs shes gal chen zhig kyang yin/ da dung rang yul gyi goms srol dang lo rgyus/ chos lugs sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang gnas bab/ khor yug sogs 'dzam gling mi dmangs la gsal zhu byed pa'i go skabs rnyed par dka' ba zhig kyang yin/'dzam gling gi yang rtser gnas pa'i bod gangs can gyi yul khams mtho ba dang / gnam gshis grang ba/ 'grim 'grul mi bde ba/ yun ring sgo ma 'byed pa bcas kyi dbang gis 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyis bod ljongs kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i rang byung khor yug dang rig gnas lo rgyus sogs la shes rtogs legs po med stabs/ yul skor ched deb sna tshogs dpar ba dang /glog 'char 'gyig sbyin phab pa/ rtsis 'khor dra ba'i lte gnas 'dzugs pa/107
